2746.label: Leviticus 1:1
2746.text: And Jehovah proceeded to call Moses and speak to him out of the tent of meeting, saying:

2747.label: Leviticus 1:2
2747.text: “Speak to the sons of Israel, and you must say to them, ‘In case some man of YOU would present an offering to Jehovah from the domestic animals, YOU should present YOUR offering from the herd and from the flock.

2748.label: Leviticus 1:3
2748.text: “‘If his offering is a burnt offering from the herd, a male, a sound one, is what he should present. At the entrance of the tent of meeting he should present it of his own free will before Jehovah.

2749.label: Leviticus 1:4
2749.text: And he must lay his hand upon the head of the burnt offering, and it must be graciously accepted for him to make atonement for him.

2750.label: Leviticus 1:5
2750.text: “‘Then the young bull must be slaughtered before Jehovah; and the sons of Aaron, the priests, must present the blood and sprinkle the blood round about upon the altar, which is at the entrance of the tent of meeting.

2751.label: Leviticus 1:6
2751.text: And the burnt offering must be skinned and cut up into its parts.

2752.label: Leviticus 1:7
2752.text: And the sons of Aaron, the priests, must put fire on the altar and set wood in order on the fire.

2753.label: Leviticus 1:8
2753.text: And the sons of Aaron, the priests, must set the pieces in order with the head and the suet over the wood that is on the fire that is on the altar.

2754.label: Leviticus 1:9
2754.text: And its intestines and its shanks will be washed with water; and the priest must make all of it smoke on the altar as a burnt offering, an offering made by fire of a restful odor to Jehovah.

2755.label: Leviticus 1:10
2755.text: “‘And if his offering for a burnt offering is from the flock, from the young rams or the goats, a male, a sound one, is what he will present.

2756.label: Leviticus 1:11
2756.text: And it must be slaughtered at the side of the altar to the north before Jehovah, and the sons of Aaron, the priests, must sprinkle its blood round about upon the altar.

2757.label: Leviticus 1:12
2757.text: And he must cut it up into its parts and its head and its suet, and the priest must set them in order over the wood that is on the fire that is on the altar.

2758.label: Leviticus 1:13
2758.text: And he will wash the intestines and the shanks with water; and the priest must present all of it and make it smoke on the altar. It is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire of a restful odor to Jehovah.

2759.label: Leviticus 1:14
2759.text: “‘However, if his offering as a burnt offering to Jehovah is from the fowls, then he must present his offering from the turtledoves or the young pigeons.

2760.label: Leviticus 1:15
2760.text: And the priest must present it at the altar and nip off its head and make it smoke upon the altar, but its blood must be drained out upon the side of the altar.

2761.label: Leviticus 1:16
2761.text: And he must remove its crop with its feathers and throw it beside the altar, to the east, to the place for the fatty ashes.

2762.label: Leviticus 1:17
2762.text: And he must cleave it at its wings. He must not divide it. Then the priest must make it smoke on the altar over the wood that is on the fire. It is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire of a restful odor to Jehovah.

2763.label: Leviticus 2:1
2763.text: “‘Now in case some soul would present as an offering a grain offering to Jehovah, his offering should prove to be fine flour; and he must pour oil over it and put frankincense upon it.

2764.label: Leviticus 2:2
2764.text: And he must bring it to the sons of Aaron, the priests, and the priest must grasp from it his handful of its fine flour and its oil along with all its frankincense; and he must make it smoke as a remembrancer of it upon the altar, as an offering made by fire of a restful odor to Jehovah.

2765.label: Leviticus 2:3
2765.text: And what is left of the grain offering belongs to Aaron and his sons, as something most holy from Jehovah’s offerings made by fire.

2766.label: Leviticus 2:4
2766.text: “‘And in case you would present as an offering a grain offering in the way of something baked in the oven, it should be of fine flour, unfermented ring-shaped cakes moistened with oil or unfermented wafers smeared with oil.

2767.label: Leviticus 2:5
2767.text: “‘And if your offering is a grain offering from off the griddle, it should prove to be of fine flour moistened with oil, unfermented.

2768.label: Leviticus 2:6
2768.text: There should be a breaking of it up into pieces, and you must pour oil upon it. It is a grain offering.

2769.label: Leviticus 2:7
2769.text: “‘And if your offering is a grain offering out of the deep-fat kettle, it should be made of fine flour with oil.

2770.label: Leviticus 2:8
2770.text: And you must bring the grain offering that was made of these to Jehovah; and it must be presented to the priest and he must bring it near to the altar.

2771.label: Leviticus 2:9
2771.text: And the priest must lift off some of the grain offering as a remembrancer of it and must make it smoke on the altar, as an offering made by fire of a restful odor to Jehovah.

2772.label: Leviticus 2:10
2772.text: And what is left of the grain offering belongs to Aaron and his sons, as something most holy of Jehovah’s offerings by fire.

2773.label: Leviticus 2:11
2773.text: “‘No grain offering that YOU will present to Jehovah should be made a leavened thing, because YOU must make no sourdough and no honey at all smoke as an offering made by fire to Jehovah.

2774.label: Leviticus 2:12
2774.text: “‘As an offering of the firstfruits, YOU will present them to Jehovah, and they must not come up onto the altar for a restful odor.

2775.label: Leviticus 2:13
2775.text: “‘And every offering of your grain offering you will season with salt; and you must not allow the salt of the covenant of your God to be missing upon your grain offering. Along with every offering of yours you will present salt.

2776.label: Leviticus 2:14
2776.text: “‘And if you would present the grain offering of the first ripe fruits to Jehovah, you should present green ears roasted with fire, the grits of new grain, as the grain offering of your first ripe fruits.

2777.label: Leviticus 2:15
2777.text: And you must put oil upon it and place frankincense upon it. It is a grain offering.

2778.label: Leviticus 2:16
2778.text: And the priest must make the remembrancer of it smoke, that is, some of its grits and oil, along with all its frankincense, as an offering made by fire to Jehovah.

2779.label: Leviticus 3:1
2779.text: “‘And if his offering is a communion sacrifice, if he is presenting it from the herd, whether a male or a female, a sound one is what he will present before Jehovah.

2780.label: Leviticus 3:2
2780.text: And he must lay his hand upon the head of his offering, and it must be slaughtered at the entrance of the tent of meeting; and Aaron’s sons, the priests, must sprinkle the blood round about upon the altar.

2781.label: Leviticus 3:3
2781.text: And he must present some of the communion sacrifice as an offering made by fire to Jehovah, namely, the fat that covers the intestines, even all the fat that is over the intestines,

2782.label: Leviticus 3:4
2782.text: and the two kidneys and the fat that is upon them, the same as that upon the loins. And as for the appendage upon the liver, he will remove it along with the kidneys.

2783.label: Leviticus 3:5
2783.text: And Aaron’s sons must make it smoke on the altar, upon the burnt offering that is over the wood that is on the fire, as an offering made by fire of a restful odor to Jehovah.

2784.label: Leviticus 3:6
2784.text: “‘And if his offering is from the flock for a communion sacrifice to Jehovah, a male or a female, a sound one is what he will present.

2785.label: Leviticus 3:7
2785.text: If he is presenting a young ram as his offering, then he must present it before Jehovah.

2786.label: Leviticus 3:8
2786.text: And he must lay his hand upon the head of his offering, and it must be slaughtered before the tent of meeting; and Aaron’s sons must sprinkle its blood round about upon the altar.

2787.label: Leviticus 3:9
2787.text: And from the communion sacrifice he must present its fat as an offering made by fire to Jehovah. The entire fatty tail is what he will remove near the backbone, and the fat that covers the intestines, even all the fat that is upon the intestines,

2788.label: Leviticus 3:10
2788.text: and the two kidneys and the fat that is upon them, the same as that upon the loins. And as for the appendage upon the liver, he will remove it along with the kidneys.

2789.label: Leviticus 3:11
2789.text: And the priest must make it smoke on the altar as food, an offering made by fire to Jehovah.

2790.label: Leviticus 3:12
2790.text: “‘And if his offering is a goat, then he must present it before Jehovah.

2791.label: Leviticus 3:13
2791.text: And he must lay his hand upon its head, and it must be slaughtered before the tent of meeting; and Aaron’s sons must sprinkle its blood round about upon the altar.

2792.label: Leviticus 3:14
2792.text: And from it he must present as his offering, as an offering made by fire to Jehovah, the fat that covers the intestines, even all the fat that is upon the intestines,

2793.label: Leviticus 3:15
2793.text: and the two kidneys and the fat that is upon them, the same as that upon the loins. And as for the appendage upon the liver, he will remove it along with the kidneys.

2794.label: Leviticus 3:16
2794.text: And the priest must make them smoke upon the altar as food, an offering made by fire for a restful odor. All the fat belongs to Jehovah.

2795.label: Leviticus 3:17
2795.text: “‘It is a statute to time indefinite for YOUR generations, in all YOUR dwelling places: YOU must not eat any fat or any blood at all.’”

2796.label: Leviticus 4:1
2796.text: And Jehovah went on to speak to Moses, saying:

2797.label: Leviticus 4:2
2797.text: “Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, ‘In case a soul sins by mistake in any of the things that Jehovah commands should not be done, and he actually does one of them:

2798.label: Leviticus 4:3
2798.text: “‘If the priest, the anointed one, sins so as to bring guiltiness upon the people, then he must present for his sin that he has committed a sound young bull to Jehovah as a sin offering.

2799.label: Leviticus 4:4
2799.text: And he must bring the bull to the entrance of the tent of meeting before Jehovah and must lay his hand upon the bull’s head, and he must slaughter the bull before Jehovah.

2800.label: Leviticus 4:5
2800.text: And the priest, the anointed one, must take some of the bull’s blood and bring it into the tent of meeting;

2801.label: Leviticus 4:6
2801.text: and the priest must dip his finger in the blood and spatter some of the blood seven times before Jehovah in front of the curtain of the holy place.

2802.label: Leviticus 4:7
2802.text: And the priest must put some of the blood upon the horns of the altar of perfumed incense before Jehovah, which is in the tent of meeting, and all the rest of the bull’s blood he will pour at the base of the altar of burnt offering, which is at the entrance of the tent of meeting.

2803.label: Leviticus 4:8
2803.text: “‘As to all the fat of the bull of the sin offering, he will lift up from it the fat that covers over the intestines, even all the fat that is over the intestines,

2804.label: Leviticus 4:9
2804.text: and the two kidneys and the fat that is upon them, the same as that upon the loins. And as for the appendage upon the liver, he will remove it along with the kidneys.

2805.label: Leviticus 4:10
2805.text: It will be the same as what is lifted up of a bull of the communion sacrifice. And the priest must make them smoke upon the altar of burnt offering.

2806.label: Leviticus 4:11
2806.text: “‘But as for the skin of the bull and all its flesh along with its head and its shanks and its intestines and its dung,

2807.label: Leviticus 4:12
2807.text: he must have the entire bull taken out to the outskirts of the camp to a clean place where the fatty ashes are poured out, and he must burn it upon wood in the fire. Where the fatty ashes are poured out it should be burned.

2808.label: Leviticus 4:13
2808.text: “‘Now if the entire assembly of Israel makes a mistake and the matter has been hidden from the eyes of the congregation in that they have done one of all the things that Jehovah commands should not be done and so have become guilty,

2809.label: Leviticus 4:14
2809.text: and the sin that they have committed against it has become known, then the congregation must present a young bull for a sin offering and must bring it before the tent of meeting.

2810.label: Leviticus 4:15
2810.text: And the older men of the assembly must lay their hands upon the bull’s head before Jehovah, and the bull must be slaughtered before Jehovah.

2811.label: Leviticus 4:16
2811.text: “‘Then the priest, the anointed one, must bring some of the bull’s blood into the tent of meeting.

2812.label: Leviticus 4:17
2812.text: And the priest must dip his finger into some of the blood and spatter it seven times before Jehovah in front of the curtain.

2813.label: Leviticus 4:18
2813.text: And he will put some of the blood upon the horns of the altar that is before Jehovah, which is in the tent of meeting; and all the rest of the blood he will pour at the base of the altar of burnt offering, which is at the entrance of the tent of meeting.

2814.label: Leviticus 4:19
2814.text: And he will lift up all its fat from it, and he must make it smoke on the altar.

2815.label: Leviticus 4:20
2815.text: And he must do to the bull just as he did to the other bull of the sin offering. That is the way he will do to it; and the priest must make an atonement for them, and so it must be forgiven them.

2816.label: Leviticus 4:21
2816.text: And he must have the bull taken out to the outskirts of the camp and must burn it, just as he burned the first bull. It is a sin offering for the congregation.

2817.label: Leviticus 4:22
2817.text: “‘When a chieftain sins and he does commit unintentionally one of all the things that Jehovah his God commands should not be done, and so has become guilty,

2818.label: Leviticus 4:23
2818.text: or his sin that he has committed against the commandment has been made known to him, then he must bring as his offering a male kid of the goats, a sound one.

2819.label: Leviticus 4:24
2819.text: And he must lay his hand upon the head of the young goat and slaughter it in the place where the burnt offering is regularly slaughtered before Jehovah. It is a sin offering.

2820.label: Leviticus 4:25
2820.text: And the priest must take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and he will pour the rest of its blood at the base of the altar of burnt offering.

2821.label: Leviticus 4:26
2821.text: And he will make all its fat smoke on the altar like the fat of the communion sacrifice; and the priest must make an atonement for him for his sin, and so it must be forgiven him.

2822.label: Leviticus 4:27
2822.text: “‘And if any soul of the people of the land sins unintentionally by his doing one of the things that Jehovah commands should not be done and he does become guilty,

2823.label: Leviticus 4:28
2823.text: or his sin that he has committed has been made known to him, then he must bring as his offering a female kid of the goats, a sound one, for his sin that he has committed.

2824.label: Leviticus 4:29
2824.text: And he must lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering and slaughter the sin offering in the same place as the burnt offering.

2825.label: Leviticus 4:30
2825.text: And the priest must take some of its blood with his finger and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and he will pour all the rest of its blood at the base of the altar.

2826.label: Leviticus 4:31
2826.text: And he will remove all its fat, just as the fat was removed from off the communion sacrifice; and the priest must make it smoke on the altar as a restful odor to Jehovah; and the priest must make an atonement for him, and so it must be forgiven him.

2827.label: Leviticus 4:32
2827.text: “‘But if he would bring a lamb as his offering for a sin offering, a sound female lamb is what he should bring.

2828.label: Leviticus 4:33
2828.text: And he must lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering and slaughter it as a sin offering in the place where the burnt offering is regularly slaughtered.

2829.label: Leviticus 4:34
2829.text: And the priest must take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and he will pour all the rest of its blood at the base of the altar.

2830.label: Leviticus 4:35
2830.text: And he will remove all its fat the same as the fat of the young ram of the communion sacrifice is regularly removed, and the priest must make them smoke on the altar upon Jehovah’s offerings made by fire; and the priest must make an atonement for him for his sin that he has committed, and so it must be forgiven him.

2831.label: Leviticus 5:1
2831.text: “‘Now in case a soul sins in that he has heard public cursing and he is a witness or he has seen it or has come to know of it, if he does not report it, then he must answer for his error.

2832.label: Leviticus 5:2
2832.text: “‘Or when a soul touches some unclean thing, whether the dead body of an unclean wild beast or the dead body of an unclean domestic animal or the dead body of an unclean swarming creature, although it has been hidden from him, still he is unclean and has become guilty.

2833.label: Leviticus 5:3
2833.text: Or in case he touches the uncleanness of a man as respects any uncleanness of his with which he may become unclean, although it had been hidden from him, and yet he himself has come to know it, then he has become guilty.

2834.label: Leviticus 5:4
2834.text: “‘Or in case a soul swears to the extent of speaking thoughtlessly with his lips to do evil or to do good as respects anything at all that the man might speak thoughtlessly in a sworn statement, although it had been hidden from him, and yet he himself has come to know it, then he has become guilty as respects one of these things.

2835.label: Leviticus 5:5
2835.text: “‘And it must occur that in case he becomes guilty as respects one of these things, then he must confess in what way he has sinned.

2836.label: Leviticus 5:6
2836.text: And he must bring his guilt offering to Jehovah for his sin that he has committed, namely, a female from the flock, a female lamb or a female kid of the goats, for a sin offering; and the priest must make an atonement for him for his sin.

2837.label: Leviticus 5:7
2837.text: “‘If, though, he cannot afford enough for a sheep, then he must bring as his guilt offering for the sin that he has committed two turtledoves or two young pigeons to Jehovah, one for a sin offering and one for a burnt offering.

2838.label: Leviticus 5:8
2838.text: And he must bring them to the priest, who must present first the one for the sin offering and nip off its head at the front of its neck, but he should not sever it.

2839.label: Leviticus 5:9
2839.text: And he must spatter some of the blood of the sin offering upon the side of the altar, but the remainder of the blood will be drained out at the base of the altar. It is a sin offering.

2840.label: Leviticus 5:10
2840.text: And the other one he will handle as a burnt offering according to the regular procedure; and the priest must make an atonement for him for his sin that he has committed, and so it must be forgiven him.

2841.label: Leviticus 5:11
2841.text: “‘Now if he does not have the means for two turtledoves or two young pigeons, then he must bring as his offering for the sin he has committed the tenth of an eʹphah of fine flour for a sin offering. He must not put oil upon it and he must not place frankincense upon it, for it is a sin offering.

2842.label: Leviticus 5:12
2842.text: And he must bring it to the priest, and the priest must grasp from it his handful as a remembrancer of it and must make it smoke on the altar upon Jehovah’s offerings made by fire. It is a sin offering.

2843.label: Leviticus 5:13
2843.text: And the priest must make an atonement for him for his sin that he has committed, any one of these sins, and so it must be forgiven him; and it must become the priest’s the same as a grain offering.’”

2844.label: Leviticus 5:14
2844.text: And Jehovah continued to speak to Moses, saying:

2845.label: Leviticus 5:15
2845.text: “In case a soul behaves unfaithfully in that he actually sins by mistake against the holy things of Jehovah, then he must bring as his guilt offering to Jehovah a sound ram from the flock, according to the estimated value in silver shekels, by the shekel of the holy place, as a guilt offering.

2846.label: Leviticus 5:16
2846.text: And he will make compensation for the sin he has committed against the holy place and he will add to it a fifth of it, and he must give it to the priest, that the priest may make an atonement for him with the ram of the guilt offering, and so it must be forgiven him.

2847.label: Leviticus 5:17
2847.text: “And if a soul sins in that he does do one of all the things that Jehovah commands should not be done, although he did not know it, yet he has become guilty and must answer for his error.

2848.label: Leviticus 5:18
2848.text: And he must bring a sound ram from the flock according to the estimated value, for a guilt offering, to the priest; and the priest must make an atonement for him for his mistake that he committed unintentionally, although he himself did not know it, and so it must be forgiven him.

2849.label: Leviticus 5:19
2849.text: It is a guilt offering. He has positively become guilty against Jehovah.”

2850.label: Leviticus 6:1
2850.text: And Jehovah went on to speak to Moses, saying:

2851.label: Leviticus 6:2
2851.text: “In case a soul sins in that he does behave unfaithfully toward Jehovah and does deceive his associate about something in his charge or a deposit in hand or a robbery or he does defraud his associate,

2852.label: Leviticus 6:3
2852.text: or he does find something lost and is actually deceptive about it and does swear falsely over any of all the things that the man might do to sin by them;

2853.label: Leviticus 6:4
2853.text: then it must occur that in case he sins and indeed becomes guilty, he must return the robbed thing which he has robbed or the extorted thing which he has taken by fraud or the thing in his charge which was put in his charge or the thing lost that he has found,

2854.label: Leviticus 6:5
2854.text: or anything at all over which he might swear falsely, and he must make compensation for it in its full amount, and he will add to it a fifth of it. To the one whose it is he will give it on the day his guilt is proved.

2855.label: Leviticus 6:6
2855.text: And as his guilt offering he will bring to Jehovah a sound ram from the flock according to the estimated value, for a guilt offering, to the priest.

2856.label: Leviticus 6:7
2856.text: And the priest must make an atonement for him before Jehovah, and so it must be forgiven him regarding any of all the things that he might do resulting in guiltiness by it.”

2857.label: Leviticus 6:8
2857.text: And Jehovah continued to speak to Moses, saying:

2858.label: Leviticus 6:9
2858.text: “Command Aaron and his sons, saying, ‘This is the law of the burnt offering: The burnt offering will be on the hearth upon the altar all night long until the morning, and the fire of the altar will be kindled in it.

2859.label: Leviticus 6:10
2859.text: And the priest must clothe himself with his official dress of linen, and he will put the linen drawers on over his flesh. Then he must lift up the fatty ashes of the burnt offering that the fire regularly consumes upon the altar, and he must place them beside the altar.

2860.label: Leviticus 6:11
2860.text: And he must strip off his garments and put on other garments, and he must take the fatty ashes out to a clean place outside the camp.

2861.label: Leviticus 6:12
2861.text: And the fire on the altar will be kept burning on it. It must not go out. And the priest must burn wood on it morning by morning and set the burnt offering in order over it, and he must make the fatty pieces of the communion sacrifices smoke over it.

2862.label: Leviticus 6:13
2862.text: Fire will be kept constantly burning on the altar. It must not go out.

2863.label: Leviticus 6:14
2863.text: “‘Now this is the law of the grain offering: YOU sons of Aaron, present it before Jehovah in front of the altar.

2864.label: Leviticus 6:15
2864.text: And one of them must lift up by his handful some of the fine flour of the grain offering and some of its oil and all the frankincense that is upon the grain offering, and he must make it smoke upon the altar as a restful odor for a remembrancer of it to Jehovah.

2865.label: Leviticus 6:16
2865.text: And what is left of it Aaron and his sons will eat. It will be eaten as unfermented cakes in a holy place. They will eat it in the courtyard of the tent of meeting.

2866.label: Leviticus 6:17
2866.text: It should not be baked with anything leavened. I have given it as their share out of my offerings made by fire. It is something most holy, like the sin offering and like the guilt offering.

2867.label: Leviticus 6:18
2867.text: Every male among the sons of Aaron will eat it. It is an allowance to time indefinite throughout YOUR generations from Jehovah’s offerings made by fire. Everything that may touch them will become holy.’”

2868.label: Leviticus 6:19
2868.text: And Jehovah went on speaking to Moses, saying:

2869.label: Leviticus 6:20
2869.text: “This is the offering of Aaron and his sons that they will present to Jehovah on the day of his being anointed: the tenth of an eʹphah of fine flour as a grain offering constantly, half of it in the morning and half of it in the evening.

2870.label: Leviticus 6:21
2870.text: It will be made with oil upon a griddle. You will bring it well mixed. You will present the pastries of the grain offering in pieces as a restful odor to Jehovah.

2871.label: Leviticus 6:22
2871.text: And the priest, the one anointed in place of him from among his sons, will make it. It is a regulation to time indefinite: As a whole offering it will be made to smoke to Jehovah.

2872.label: Leviticus 6:23
2872.text: And every grain offering of a priest should prove to be a whole offering. It must not be eaten.”

2873.label: Leviticus 6:24
2873.text: And Jehovah spoke further to Moses, saying:

2874.label: Leviticus 6:25
2874.text: “Speak to Aaron and his sons, saying, ‘This is the law of the sin offering: In the place where the burnt offering is regularly slaughtered the sin offering will be slaughtered before Jehovah. It is a most holy thing.

2875.label: Leviticus 6:26
2875.text: The priest who offers it for sin will eat it. In a holy place it will be eaten in the courtyard of the tent of meeting.

2876.label: Leviticus 6:27
2876.text: “‘Everything that may touch its flesh will become holy, and when anyone spatters some of its blood upon the garment, you will wash what he spatters blood upon in a holy place.

2877.label: Leviticus 6:28
2877.text: And the earthenware vessel in which it may be boiled is to be shattered. But if it was boiled in a copper vessel, then it must be scoured and rinsed with water.

2878.label: Leviticus 6:29
2878.text: “‘Every male among the priests will eat it. It is something most holy.

2879.label: Leviticus 6:30
2879.text: However, no sin offering of which some of the blood will be brought into the tent of meeting to make atonement in the holy place must be eaten. It is to be burned with fire.

2880.label: Leviticus 7:1
2880.text: “‘And this is the law of the guilt offering: It is something most holy.

2881.label: Leviticus 7:2
2881.text: In the place where they regularly slaughter the burnt offering they will slaughter the guilt offering, and its blood one will sprinkle round about upon the altar.

2882.label: Leviticus 7:3
2882.text: As for all its fat, he will present of it the fatty tail and the fat that covers the intestines,

2883.label: Leviticus 7:4
2883.text: and the two kidneys and the fat that is upon them the same as that upon the loins. And as for the appendage upon the liver, he will remove it along with the kidneys.

2884.label: Leviticus 7:5
2884.text: And the priest must make them smoke on the altar as an offering made by fire to Jehovah. It is a guilt offering.

2885.label: Leviticus 7:6
2885.text: Every male among the priests will eat it. In a holy place it will be eaten. It is something most holy.

2886.label: Leviticus 7:7
2886.text: Like the sin offering, so is the guilt offering. There is one law for them. The priest who will make atonement with it, his it will become.

2887.label: Leviticus 7:8
2887.text: “‘As for the priest who presents the burnt offering of any man, the skin of the burnt offering that he has presented to the priest will become his.

2888.label: Leviticus 7:9
2888.text: “‘And every grain offering that may be baked in the oven and every one made in the deep-fat kettle and upon the griddle belongs to the priest who presents it. It will become his.

2889.label: Leviticus 7:10
2889.text: But every grain offering that is moistened with oil or dry will come to be for all of Aaron’s sons, for the one the same as for the other.

2890.label: Leviticus 7:11
2890.text: “‘Now this is the law of the communion sacrifice that anyone will present to Jehovah:

2891.label: Leviticus 7:12
2891.text: If he would present it in expression of thanksgiving, then he must present along with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unfermented ring-shaped cakes moistened with oil and unfermented wafers smeared with oil and well-mixed fine flour as ring-shaped cakes moistened with oil.

2892.label: Leviticus 7:13
2892.text: Along with ring-shaped cakes of leavened bread he will present his offering together with the thanksgiving sacrifice of his communion sacrifices.

2893.label: Leviticus 7:14
2893.text: And out of it he must present one of each offering as a sacred portion to Jehovah; as for the priest who sprinkles the blood of the communion sacrifices, it will become his.

2894.label: Leviticus 7:15
2894.text: And the flesh of the thanksgiving sacrifice of his communion sacrifices is to be eaten on the day of his offering. He must not save up any of it until morning.

2895.label: Leviticus 7:16
2895.text: “‘And if the sacrifice of his offering is a vow or a voluntary offering, it is to be eaten on the day of his presenting his sacrifice, and on the next day what is left of it also may be eaten.

2896.label: Leviticus 7:17
2896.text: But what is left of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day is to be burned with fire.

2897.label: Leviticus 7:18
2897.text: However, if any of the flesh of his communion sacrifice should at all be eaten on the third day, the one presenting it will not be accepted with approval. It will not be put to his account. It will become a foul thing, and the soul that eats some of it will answer for his error.

2898.label: Leviticus 7:19
2898.text: And the flesh that may touch anything unclean is not to be eaten. It is to be burned with fire. As for the flesh, everybody clean may eat the flesh.

2899.label: Leviticus 7:20
2899.text: “‘And the soul who eats the flesh of the communion sacrifice, which is for Jehovah, while his uncleanness is upon him, that soul must be cut off from his people.

2900.label: Leviticus 7:21
2900.text: And in case a soul touches anything unclean, the uncleanness of a man or an unclean beast or any unclean loathsome thing, and actually eats some of the flesh of the communion sacrifice, which is for Jehovah, that soul must be cut off from his people.’”

2901.label: Leviticus 7:22
2901.text: And Jehovah continued to speak to Moses, saying:

2902.label: Leviticus 7:23
2902.text: “Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, ‘YOU must not eat any fat of a bull or a young ram or a goat.

2903.label: Leviticus 7:24
2903.text: Now the fat of a body [already] dead and the fat of an animal torn to pieces may be used for anything else conceivable, but YOU must not eat it at all.

2904.label: Leviticus 7:25
2904.text: For anyone eating fat from the beast from which he presents it as an offering made by fire to Jehovah, the soul that eats must be cut off from his people.

2905.label: Leviticus 7:26
2905.text: “‘And YOU must not eat any blood in any places where YOU dwell, whether that of fowl or that of beast.

2906.label: Leviticus 7:27
2906.text: Any soul who eats any blood, that soul must be cut off from his people.’”

2907.label: Leviticus 7:28
2907.text: And Jehovah went on to speak to Moses, saying:

2908.label: Leviticus 7:29
2908.text: “Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, ‘He who presents his communion sacrifice to Jehovah will bring his offering to Jehovah from his communion sacrifice.

2909.label: Leviticus 7:30
2909.text: His hands will bring as Jehovah’s offerings made by fire the fat upon the breast. He will bring it with the breast to wave it to and fro as a wave offering before Jehovah.

2910.label: Leviticus 7:31
2910.text: And the priest must make the fat smoke upon the altar, but the breast must become Aaron’s and his sons’.

2911.label: Leviticus 7:32
2911.text: “‘And YOU will give the right leg as a sacred portion to the priest from YOUR communion sacrifices.

2912.label: Leviticus 7:33
2912.text: That one of Aaron’s sons who presents the blood of the communion sacrifices and the fat, the right leg will become his as a portion.

2913.label: Leviticus 7:34
2913.text: For the breast of the wave offering and the leg of the sacred portion I do take from the sons of Israel from their communion sacrifices, and I shall give them to Aaron the priest and his sons, as a regulation to time indefinite, from the sons of Israel.

2914.label: Leviticus 7:35
2914.text: “‘This was the priestly share of Aaron and the priestly share of his sons from Jehovah’s offerings made by fire, on the day that he presented them to act as priests to Jehovah,

2915.label: Leviticus 7:36
2915.text: just as Jehovah had commanded to give it to them on the day of his anointing them from among the sons of Israel. It is a statute to time indefinite for their generations.’”

2916.label: Leviticus 7:37
2916.text: This is the law concerning the burnt offering, the grain offering and the sin offering and the guilt offering and the installation sacrifice and the communion sacrifice,

2917.label: Leviticus 7:38
2917.text: just as Jehovah had commanded Moses in Mount Siʹnai in the day of his commanding the sons of Israel to present their offerings to Jehovah in the wilderness of Siʹnai.

2918.label: Leviticus 8:1
2918.text: And Jehovah proceeded to speak to Moses, saying:

2919.label: Leviticus 8:2
2919.text: “Take Aaron and his sons with him and the garments and the anointing oil and the bull of the sin offering and the two rams and the basket of unfermented cakes,

2920.label: Leviticus 8:3
2920.text: and make all the assembly congregate at the entrance of the tent of meeting.”

2921.label: Leviticus 8:4
2921.text: Then Moses did just as Jehovah had commanded him, and the assembly congregated at the entrance of the tent of meeting.

2922.label: Leviticus 8:5
2922.text: Moses now said to the assembly: “This is the thing that Jehovah has given command to do.”

2923.label: Leviticus 8:6
2923.text: So Moses brought Aaron and his sons near and washed them with water.

2924.label: Leviticus 8:7
2924.text: After that he put the robe upon him and girded him with the sash and clothed him with the sleeveless coat and put the ephʹod upon him and girded him with the girdle of the ephʹod and bound it closely to him with it.

2925.label: Leviticus 8:8
2925.text: Next he placed the breastpiece upon him and put in the breastpiece the Uʹrim and the Thumʹmim.

2926.label: Leviticus 8:9
2926.text: Then he placed the turban upon his head and placed upon the turban at the forefront of it the shining plate of gold, the holy sign of dedication, just as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

2927.label: Leviticus 8:10
2927.text: Moses now took the anointing oil and anointed the tabernacle and all that was in it and sanctified them.

2928.label: Leviticus 8:11
2928.text: After that he spattered some of it seven times upon the altar and anointed the altar and all its utensils and the basin and its stand so as to sanctify them.

2929.label: Leviticus 8:12
2929.text: Finally he poured some of the anointing oil upon Aaron’s head and anointed him so as to sanctify him.

2930.label: Leviticus 8:13
2930.text: Moses then brought Aaron’s sons near and clothed them with robes and girded them with sashes and wrapped the headgear upon them, just as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

2931.label: Leviticus 8:14
2931.text: Then he led up the bull of the sin offering and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the bull of the sin offering.

2932.label: Leviticus 8:15
2932.text: And Moses proceeded to slaughter it and take the blood and put it with his finger upon the horns of the altar round about and purify the altar from sin, but the rest of the blood he poured at the base of the altar, that he might sanctify it to make atonement upon it.

2933.label: Leviticus 8:16
2933.text: After that he took all the fat that was upon the intestines, and the appendage of the liver and the two kidneys and their fat and Moses made them smoke upon the altar.

2934.label: Leviticus 8:17
2934.text: And he had the bull and its skin and its flesh and its dung burned with fire outside the camp, just as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

2935.label: Leviticus 8:18
2935.text: He now brought the ram of the burnt offering near, and Aaron and his sons then laid their hands upon the head of the ram.

2936.label: Leviticus 8:19
2936.text: After that Moses slaughtered it and sprinkled the blood round about upon the altar.

2937.label: Leviticus 8:20
2937.text: And he cut up the ram into its pieces, and Moses proceeded to make the head and the pieces and the suet smoke.

2938.label: Leviticus 8:21
2938.text: And the intestines and the shanks he washed with water, and Moses then made the entire ram smoke upon the altar. It was a burnt offering for a restful odor. It was an offering made by fire to Jehovah, just as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

2939.label: Leviticus 8:22
2939.text: Then he brought the second ram, the ram of the installation, near, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the ram’s head.

2940.label: Leviticus 8:23
2940.text: After that Moses slaughtered it and took some of its blood and put it upon the lobe of Aaron’s right ear and upon the thumb of his right hand and upon the big toe of his right foot.

2941.label: Leviticus 8:24
2941.text: Next Moses brought Aaron’s sons near and put some of the blood upon the lobe of their right ear and upon the thumb of their right hand and upon the big toe of their right foot; but Moses sprinkled the rest of the blood round about upon the altar.

2942.label: Leviticus 8:25
2942.text: Then he took the fat and the fat tail and all the fat that was upon the intestines, and the appendage of the liver and the two kidneys and their fat and the right leg.

2943.label: Leviticus 8:26
2943.text: And out of the basket of unfermented cakes that was before Jehovah he took one unfermented ring-shaped cake and one ring-shaped cake of oiled bread and one wafer. He then placed them upon the fatty pieces and the right leg.

2944.label: Leviticus 8:27
2944.text: After that he put all of them upon the palms of Aaron and the palms of his sons and began to wave them to and fro as a wave offering before Jehovah.

2945.label: Leviticus 8:28
2945.text: Then Moses took them off their palms and made them smoke upon the altar on top of the burnt offering. They were an installation sacrifice for a restful odor. It was an offering made by fire to Jehovah.

2946.label: Leviticus 8:29
2946.text: And Moses proceeded to take the breast and to wave it to and fro as a wave offering before Jehovah. From the installation ram it became the portion for Moses, just as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

2947.label: Leviticus 8:30
2947.text: After that Moses took some of the anointing oil and some of the blood that was upon the altar and spattered it upon Aaron and his garments and upon his sons and the garments of his sons with him. Thus he sanctified Aaron and his garments and his sons and the garments of his sons with him.

2948.label: Leviticus 8:31
2948.text: Then Moses said to Aaron and his sons: “Boil the flesh at the entrance of the tent of meeting, and there is where YOU will eat it and the bread that is in the installation basket, just as I was given the command, saying, ‘Aaron and his sons will eat it.’

2949.label: Leviticus 8:32
2949.text: And what is left over of the flesh and the bread YOU will burn with fire.

2950.label: Leviticus 8:33
2950.text: And YOU must not go out from the entrance of the tent of meeting for seven days, until the day of fulfilling the days of YOUR installation, because it will take seven days to fill YOUR hand with power.

2951.label: Leviticus 8:34
2951.text: Just as it has been done this day, Jehovah has commanded to be done so as to make atonement for YOU.

2952.label: Leviticus 8:35
2952.text: And YOU will stay at the entrance of the tent of meeting day and night for seven days, and YOU must keep the obligatory watch of Jehovah, that YOU may not die; for so I have been commanded.”

2953.label: Leviticus 8:36
2953.text: And Aaron and his sons proceeded to do all the things that Jehovah had commanded by means of Moses.

2954.label: Leviticus 9:1
2954.text: And it came about on the eighth day that Moses called Aaron and his sons and the older men of Israel.

2955.label: Leviticus 9:2
2955.text: Then he said to Aaron: “Take for yourself a young calf for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering, sound ones, and present them before Jehovah.

2956.label: Leviticus 9:3
2956.text: But to the sons of Israel you will speak, saying, ‘Take a male goat for a sin offering and a calf and a young ram, each a year old, sound ones, for a burnt offering,

2957.label: Leviticus 9:4
2957.text: and a bull and a ram for communion sacrifices to sacrifice them before Jehovah, and a grain offering moistened with oil, because today is when Jehovah will certainly appear to YOU.’”

2958.label: Leviticus 9:5
2958.text: Accordingly they took what Moses had commanded before the tent of meeting. Then the whole assembly came near and stood before Jehovah.

2959.label: Leviticus 9:6
2959.text: And Moses went on to say: “This is the thing that Jehovah has commanded YOU should do, that the glory of Jehovah may appear to YOU.”

2960.label: Leviticus 9:7
2960.text: Then Moses said to Aaron: “Go near to the altar and render up your sin offering and your burnt offering, and make atonement in your own behalf and in behalf of your house; and render up the offering of the people and make atonement in their behalf, just as Jehovah has commanded.”

2961.label: Leviticus 9:8
2961.text: Aaron immediately went near to the altar and slaughtered the calf of the sin offering that was for him.

2962.label: Leviticus 9:9
2962.text: Then Aaron’s sons presented the blood to him and he dipped his finger in the blood and put it upon the horns of the altar, and the rest of the blood he poured at the base of the altar.

2963.label: Leviticus 9:10
2963.text: And he made the fat and the kidneys and the appendage of the liver from the sin offering smoke upon the altar, just as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

2964.label: Leviticus 9:11
2964.text: And he burned the flesh and the skin with fire outside the camp.

2965.label: Leviticus 9:12
2965.text: Then he slaughtered the burnt offering and Aaron’s sons handed him the blood and he sprinkled it round about upon the altar.

2966.label: Leviticus 9:13
2966.text: And they handed him the burnt offering in its pieces and the head, and he proceeded to make them smoke upon the altar.

2967.label: Leviticus 9:14
2967.text: Further, he washed the intestines and the shanks and made them smoke upon the burnt offering on the altar.

2968.label: Leviticus 9:15
2968.text: He now went presenting the offering of the people and took the goat of the sin offering that was for the people and slaughtered it and made an offering for sin with it as with the first.

2969.label: Leviticus 9:16
2969.text: Then he presented the burnt offering and handled it according to the regular procedure.

2970.label: Leviticus 9:17
2970.text: He next presented the grain offering and filled his hand with some of it and made it smoke upon the altar, apart from the burnt offering of the morning.

2971.label: Leviticus 9:18
2971.text: After that he slaughtered the bull and the ram of the communion sacrifice that was for the people. Then Aaron’s sons handed him the blood and he sprinkled it round about upon the altar.

2972.label: Leviticus 9:19
2972.text: As for the fatty pieces of the bull and the fat tail of the ram and the fat covering and the kidneys and the appendage of the liver,

2973.label: Leviticus 9:20
2973.text: they now placed the fatty pieces upon the breasts, after which he made the fatty pieces smoke upon the altar.

2974.label: Leviticus 9:21
2974.text: But the breasts and the right leg Aaron waved to and fro as a wave offering before Jehovah, just as Moses had commanded.

2975.label: Leviticus 9:22
2975.text: Then Aaron raised his hands toward the people and blessed them and came down from rendering the sin offering and the burnt offering and the communion sacrifices.

2976.label: Leviticus 9:23
2976.text: Finally Moses and Aaron went into the tent of meeting and came out and blessed the people. Then Jehovah’s glory appeared to all the people,

2977.label: Leviticus 9:24
2977.text: and fire came out from before Jehovah and began consuming the burnt offering and the fatty pieces upon the altar. When all the people got to see it, they broke out into shouting and went falling upon their faces.

2978.label: Leviticus 10:1
2978.text: Later on Aaron’s sons Naʹdab and A·biʹhu took up and brought each one his fire holder and put fire in them and placed incense upon it, and they began offering before Jehovah illegitimate fire, which he had not prescribed for them.

2979.label: Leviticus 10:2
2979.text: At this a fire came out from before Jehovah and consumed them, so that they died before Jehovah.

2980.label: Leviticus 10:3
2980.text: Then Moses said to Aaron: “This is what Jehovah has spoken, saying, ‘Among those near to me let me be sanctified, and before the face of all the people let me be glorified.’” And Aaron kept silent.

2981.label: Leviticus 10:4
2981.text: So Moses called Mishʹa·el and El·zaʹphan, the sons of Uzʹzi·el, Aaron’s uncle, and said to them: “Come near, carry YOUR brothers from in front of the holy place to outside the camp.”

2982.label: Leviticus 10:5
2982.text: They accordingly came near and carried them in their robes to outside the camp, just as Moses had spoken.

2983.label: Leviticus 10:6
2983.text: Subsequently Moses said to Aaron and to El·e·aʹzar and Ithʹa·mar his [other] sons: “Do not let YOUR heads go ungroomed, and YOU must not tear YOUR garments, that YOU may not die and that he may not become indignant against all the assembly; but YOUR brothers of the whole house of Israel will do the weeping over the burning, which Jehovah has made burn.

2984.label: Leviticus 10:7
2984.text: And from the entrance of the tent of meeting YOU must not go out for fear YOU may die, because Jehovah’s anointing oil is upon YOU.” So they did according to Moses’ word.

2985.label: Leviticus 10:8
2985.text: And Jehovah proceeded to speak to Aaron, saying:

2986.label: Leviticus 10:9
2986.text: “Do not drink wine or intoxicating liquor, you and your sons with you, when YOU come into the tent of meeting, that YOU may not die. It is a statute to time indefinite for YOUR generations,

2987.label: Leviticus 10:10
2987.text: both in order to make a distinction between the holy thing and the profane and between the unclean thing and the clean,

2988.label: Leviticus 10:11
2988.text: and in order to teach the sons of Israel all the regulations that Jehovah has spoken to them by means of Moses.”

2989.label: Leviticus 10:12
2989.text: Then Moses spoke to Aaron and to El·e·aʹzar and Ithʹa·mar, his sons that were left: “Take the grain offering that was left over from Jehovah’s offerings made by fire and eat it unfermented near the altar, because it is something most holy.

2990.label: Leviticus 10:13
2990.text: And YOU must eat it in a holy place, because it is your allowance and the allowance of your sons from Jehovah’s offerings made by fire; for so I have been commanded.

2991.label: Leviticus 10:14
2991.text: And YOU will eat the breast of the wave offering and the leg of the sacred portion in a clean place, you and your sons and your daughters with you, because they have been given as your allowance and the allowance of your sons from the communion sacrifices of the sons of Israel.

2992.label: Leviticus 10:15
2992.text: They will bring the leg of the sacred portion and the breast of the wave offering along with the offerings made by fire, of the fatty pieces, in order to wave the wave offering to and fro before Jehovah; and it must serve as an allowance to time indefinite for you and your sons with you, just as Jehovah has commanded.”

2993.label: Leviticus 10:16
2993.text: And Moses searched thoroughly for the goat of the sin offering, and, look! it had been burned up. So he grew indignant at El·e·aʹzar and Ithʹa·mar, Aaron’s sons that were left, saying:

2994.label: Leviticus 10:17
2994.text: “Why did YOU not eat the sin offering in the place that is holy, since it is something most holy and he has given it to YOU that YOU may answer for the error of the assembly so as to make atonement for them before Jehovah?

2995.label: Leviticus 10:18
2995.text: Look! Its blood has not been brought into the holy place within. YOU should have eaten it without fail in the holy place, just as I had been commanded.”

2996.label: Leviticus 10:19
2996.text: At this Aaron spoke to Moses: “Look! Today they have presented their sin offering and their burnt offering before Jehovah, while such things as these began to befall me; and had I eaten the sin offering today, would it prove satisfactory in Jehovah’s eyes?”

2997.label: Leviticus 10:20
2997.text: When Moses got to hear that, then it proved satisfactory in his eyes.

2998.label: Leviticus 11:1
2998.text: And Jehovah proceeded to speak to Moses and Aaron, saying to them:

2999.label: Leviticus 11:2
2999.text: “Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, ‘This is the living creature that YOU may eat of all the beasts that are upon the earth:

3000.label: Leviticus 11:3
3000.text: Every creature that splits the hoof and forms a cleft in the hoofs and chews the cud among the beasts, that is what YOU may eat.

3001.label: Leviticus 11:4
3001.text: “‘Only this is what YOU must not eat among the chewers of the cud and the splitters of the hoof: the camel, because it is a chewer of the cud but is no splitter of the hoof. It is unclean for YOU.

3002.label: Leviticus 11:5
3002.text: Also the rock badger, because it is a chewer of the cud but does not split the hoof. It is unclean for YOU.

3003.label: Leviticus 11:6
3003.text: Also the hare, because it is a chewer of the cud but it does not have the hoof split. It is unclean for YOU.

3004.label: Leviticus 11:7
3004.text: Also the pig, because it is a splitter of the hoof and a former of a cleft in the hoof, but it itself does not chew the cud. It is unclean for YOU.

3005.label: Leviticus 11:8
3005.text: YOU must not eat any of their flesh, and YOU must not touch their dead body. They are unclean for YOU.

3006.label: Leviticus 11:9
3006.text: “‘This is what YOU may eat of everything that is in the waters: Everything that has fins and scales in the waters, in the seas and in the torrents, those YOU may eat.

3007.label: Leviticus 11:10
3007.text: And everything in the seas and the torrents that has no fins and scales, out of every swarming creature of the waters and out of every living soul that is in the waters, they are a loathsome thing for YOU.

3008.label: Leviticus 11:11
3008.text: Yes, they will become a loathsome thing to YOU. YOU must not eat any of their flesh, and YOU are to loathe their dead body.

3009.label: Leviticus 11:12
3009.text: Everything in the waters that has no fins and scales is a loathsome thing to YOU.

3010.label: Leviticus 11:13
3010.text: “‘And these are what YOU will loathe among the flying creatures. They should not be eaten. They are a loathsome thing: the eagle and the osprey and the black vulture,

3011.label: Leviticus 11:14
3011.text: and the red kite and the black kite according to its kind,

3012.label: Leviticus 11:15
3012.text: and every raven according to its kind,

3013.label: Leviticus 11:16
3013.text: and the ostrich and the owl and the gull and the falcon according to its kind,

3014.label: Leviticus 11:17
3014.text: and the little owl and the cormorant and the long-eared owl,

3015.label: Leviticus 11:18
3015.text: and the swan and the pelican and the vulture,

3016.label: Leviticus 11:19
3016.text: and the stork, the heron according to its kind, and the hoopoe and the bat.

3017.label: Leviticus 11:20
3017.text: Every winged swarming creature that goes on all fours is a loathsome thing to YOU.

3018.label: Leviticus 11:21
3018.text: “‘Only this is what YOU may eat of all the winged swarming creatures that go upon all fours, those that have leaper legs above their feet with which to leap upon the earth.

3019.label: Leviticus 11:22
3019.text: These are the ones of them YOU may eat of: the migratory locust according to its kind, and the edible locust after its kind, and the cricket according to its kind, and the grasshopper according to its kind.

3020.label: Leviticus 11:23
3020.text: And every other winged swarming creature that does have four legs is a loathsome thing to YOU.

3021.label: Leviticus 11:24
3021.text: So by these YOU would make yourselves unclean. Everyone touching their dead bodies will be unclean until the evening.

3022.label: Leviticus 11:25
3022.text: And everyone carrying any of their dead bodies will wash his garments, and he must be unclean until the evening.

3023.label: Leviticus 11:26
3023.text: “‘As for any beast that is a splitter of the hoof but is not a former of a cleft and is not a chewer of the cud, they are unclean for YOU. Everyone touching them will be unclean.

3024.label: Leviticus 11:27
3024.text: As for every creature going upon its paws among all the living creatures that go on all fours, they are unclean to YOU. Everyone touching their dead bodies will be unclean until the evening.

3025.label: Leviticus 11:28
3025.text: And he who carries their dead bodies will wash his garments, and he must be unclean until the evening. They are unclean to YOU.

3026.label: Leviticus 11:29
3026.text: “‘And this is what is unclean to YOU among the swarming creatures that swarm upon the earth: the mole rat and the jerboa and the lizard according to its kind,

3027.label: Leviticus 11:30
3027.text: and the gecko fanfoot and the large lizard and the newt and the sand lizard and the chameleon.

3028.label: Leviticus 11:31
3028.text: These are unclean to YOU among all the swarming creatures. Everyone touching them in their death state will be unclean until the evening.

3029.label: Leviticus 11:32
3029.text: “‘Now anything upon which any of them should fall in its death state will be unclean, whether it be some wooden vessel or a garment or a skin or sackcloth. Any vessel of which some use is made will be put in water, and it must be unclean until the evening and then be clean.

3030.label: Leviticus 11:33
3030.text: As for any earthenware vessel into which any of them should fall, anything that is within it will be unclean, and YOU will smash it.

3031.label: Leviticus 11:34
3031.text: Any sort of food that may be eaten upon which water may come from it will be unclean, and any drink that may be drunk in any vessel will be unclean.

3032.label: Leviticus 11:35
3032.text: And everything upon which any of their dead bodies may fall will be unclean. Whether oven or jar stand, it is to be broken down. They are unclean, and they will become unclean to YOU.

3033.label: Leviticus 11:36
3033.text: Only a spring and a pit of impounded waters will continue clean, but anyone touching their dead bodies will be unclean.

3034.label: Leviticus 11:37
3034.text: And should any of their dead bodies fall upon any seed of a plant that is to be sown, it is clean.

3035.label: Leviticus 11:38
3035.text: But in case water should be put upon seed and something of their dead bodies had fallen upon it, it is unclean to YOU.

3036.label: Leviticus 11:39
3036.text: “‘Now in case any beast that is YOURS for food should die, he who touches its dead body will be unclean until the evening.

3037.label: Leviticus 11:40
3037.text: And he who eats any of its dead body will wash his garments, and he must be unclean until the evening; and he who carries off its dead body will wash his garments, and he must be unclean until the evening.

3038.label: Leviticus 11:41
3038.text: And every swarming creature that swarms upon the earth is a loathsome thing. It must not be eaten.

3039.label: Leviticus 11:42
3039.text: As for any creature that goes upon the belly and any creature that goes on all fours or any great number of feet of all the swarming creatures that swarm upon the earth, YOU must not eat them, because they are a loathsome thing.

3040.label: Leviticus 11:43
3040.text: Do not make YOUR souls loathsome with any swarming creature that swarms, and YOU must not make yourselves unclean by them and actually get unclean by them.

3041.label: Leviticus 11:44
3041.text: For I am Jehovah YOUR God; and YOU must sanctify yourselves and YOU must prove yourselves holy, because I am holy. So YOU must not make YOUR souls unclean by any swarming creature that moves upon the earth.

3042.label: Leviticus 11:45
3042.text: For I am Jehovah who is leading YOU up out of the land of Egypt to prove myself God to YOU; and YOU must prove yourselves holy, because I am holy.

3043.label: Leviticus 11:46
3043.text: “‘This is the law about the beast and the flying creature and every living soul that moves about in the waters and concerning every soul that swarms upon the earth,

3044.label: Leviticus 11:47
3044.text: in order to make a distinction between the unclean and the clean and between the living creature that is eatable and the living creature that may not be eaten.’”

3045.label: Leviticus 12:1
3045.text: And Jehovah went on to speak to Moses, saying:

3046.label: Leviticus 12:2
3046.text: “Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, ‘In case a woman conceives seed and does bear a male, she must be unclean seven days; as in the days of the impurity when she is menstruating she will be unclean.

3047.label: Leviticus 12:3
3047.text: And on the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin will be circumcised.

3048.label: Leviticus 12:4
3048.text: For thirty-three days more she will stay in the blood of purification. She should not touch any holy thing, and she should not come into the holy place until the fulfilling of the days of her purification.

3049.label: Leviticus 12:5
3049.text: “‘Now if she should bear a female, she must then be unclean fourteen days, as during her menstruation. For sixty-six days more she will stay with the blood of purification.

3050.label: Leviticus 12:6
3050.text: Then at the fulfilling of the days of her purification for a son or for a daughter she will bring a young ram in its first year for a burnt offering and a young pigeon or a turtledove for a sin offering to the entrance of the tent of meeting to the priest.

3051.label: Leviticus 12:7
3051.text: And he must present it before Jehovah and make atonement for her, and she must be clean from the source of her blood. This is the law about her who bears either a male or a female.

3052.label: Leviticus 12:8
3052.text: But if she cannot afford enough for a sheep, she must then take two turtledoves or two young pigeons, one for a burnt offering and one for a sin offering, and the priest must make atonement for her, and she must be clean.’”

3053.label: Leviticus 13:1
3053.text: And Jehovah proceeded to speak to Moses and Aaron, saying:

3054.label: Leviticus 13:2
3054.text: “In case a man develops in the skin of his flesh an eruption or a scab or a blotch and it does develop in the skin of his flesh into the plague of leprosy, he must then be brought to Aaron the priest or to one of his sons the priests.

3055.label: Leviticus 13:3
3055.text: And the priest must look at the plague in the skin of the flesh. When the hair in the plague has turned white and the appearance of the plague is deeper than the skin of his flesh, it is the plague of leprosy. And the priest must look at it, and he must declare him unclean.

3056.label: Leviticus 13:4
3056.text: But if the blotch is white in the skin of his flesh and its appearance is not deeper than the skin and its hair has not turned white, the priest must then quarantine the plague seven days.

3057.label: Leviticus 13:5
3057.text: And the priest must look at him on the seventh day, and if in the way it looks the plague has stopped, the plague has not spread in the skin, the priest must also quarantine him another seven days.

3058.label: Leviticus 13:6
3058.text: “And the priest must look at him on the seventh day the second time, and if the plague has grown dull and the plague has not spread in the skin, the priest must also pronounce him clean. It was a scab. And he must wash his garments and be clean.

3059.label: Leviticus 13:7
3059.text: But if the scab has unquestionably spread in the skin after his appearing before the priest for the establishment of his purification, he must then appear the second time before the priest,

3060.label: Leviticus 13:8
3060.text: and the priest must take a look; and if the scab has spread in the skin, the priest must then declare him unclean. It is leprosy.

3061.label: Leviticus 13:9
3061.text: “In case the plague of leprosy develops in a man, he must then be brought to the priest.

3062.label: Leviticus 13:10
3062.text: And the priest must take a look; and if there is a white eruption in the skin and it has turned the hair white and the raw of the living flesh is in the eruption,

3063.label: Leviticus 13:11
3063.text: it is chronic leprosy in the skin of his flesh; and the priest must declare him unclean. He should not quarantine him, for he is unclean.

3064.label: Leviticus 13:12
3064.text: Now if the leprosy unquestionably breaks out in the skin, and the leprosy does cover all the skin of the one with the plague from his head to his feet to the full sight of the priest’s eyes;

3065.label: Leviticus 13:13
3065.text: and the priest has looked and there the leprosy has covered all his flesh, he must then pronounce the plague clean. All of it has turned white. He is clean.

3066.label: Leviticus 13:14
3066.text: But on the day the living flesh appears in it, he will be unclean.

3067.label: Leviticus 13:15
3067.text: And the priest must see the living flesh, and he must declare him unclean. The living flesh is unclean. It is leprosy.

3068.label: Leviticus 13:16
3068.text: Or in case the living flesh goes back and it does change to white, he must then come to the priest.

3069.label: Leviticus 13:17
3069.text: And the priest must look at him, and if the plague has been changed to white, the priest must then pronounce the plague clean. He is clean.

3070.label: Leviticus 13:18
3070.text: “As for the flesh, in case a boil develops in its skin and it does get healed,

3071.label: Leviticus 13:19
3071.text: and in the place of the boil a white eruption has developed or a reddish-white blotch, he must then show himself to the priest.

3072.label: Leviticus 13:20
3072.text: And the priest must look, and if its appearance is lower than the skin and its hair has turned white, the priest must then declare him unclean. It is the plague of leprosy. It has broken out in the boil.

3073.label: Leviticus 13:21
3073.text: But if the priest looks at it, and, there now, there is no white hair in it and it is not deeper than the skin and it is dull, the priest must then quarantine him seven days.

3074.label: Leviticus 13:22
3074.text: And if it unmistakably spreads in the skin, the priest must then declare him unclean. It is a plague.

3075.label: Leviticus 13:23
3075.text: But if in its place the blotch should stand, it has not spread, it is the inflammation of the boil; and the priest must pronounce him clean.

3076.label: Leviticus 13:24
3076.text: “Or in case there comes to be a scar in the skin of the flesh from the fire, and the raw flesh of the scar does become a reddish-white blotch or a white one,

3077.label: Leviticus 13:25
3077.text: the priest must then look at it; and if the hair has been changed white in the blotch and its appearance is deeper than the skin, it is leprosy. It has broken out in the scar, and the priest must declare him unclean. It is the plague of leprosy.

3078.label: Leviticus 13:26
3078.text: But if the priest looks at it, and, there now, there is no white hair in the blotch and it is not lower than the skin and it is dull, the priest must then quarantine him seven days.

3079.label: Leviticus 13:27
3079.text: And the priest must look at him on the seventh day. If it unmistakably spreads in the skin, the priest must then declare him unclean. It is the plague of leprosy.

3080.label: Leviticus 13:28
3080.text: But if the blotch stands in its place, it has not spread in the skin and it is dull, it is an eruption of the scar; and the priest must pronounce him clean, because it is an inflammation of the scar.

3081.label: Leviticus 13:29
3081.text: “As for a man or a woman, in case a plague develops in such one on the head or on the chin,

3082.label: Leviticus 13:30
3082.text: the priest must then see the plague; and if its appearance is deeper than the skin, and the hair is yellow and scarce in it, the priest must then declare such one unclean. It is an abnormal falling off of hair. It is leprosy of the head or of the chin.

3083.label: Leviticus 13:31
3083.text: But in case the priest sees the plague of abnormal falling off of hair, and, look! its appearance is not deeper than the skin and there is no black hair in it, the priest must then quarantine the plague of abnormal falling off of hair seven days.

3084.label: Leviticus 13:32
3084.text: And the priest must look at the plague on the seventh day; and if the abnormal falling off of hair has not spread, and no yellow hair has developed in it and the appearance of the abnormal falling off of hair is not deeper than the skin,

3085.label: Leviticus 13:33
3085.text: he must then have himself shaved, but he will not have the abnormal falling off of hair shaved; and the priest must quarantine the abnormal falling off of hair seven days again.

3086.label: Leviticus 13:34
3086.text: “And the priest must look at the abnormal falling off of hair on the seventh day; and if the abnormal falling off of hair has not spread in the skin, and its appearance is not deeper than the skin, the priest must then pronounce him clean, and he must wash his garments and be clean.

3087.label: Leviticus 13:35
3087.text: But if the abnormal falling off of hair unmistakably spreads in the skin after the establishment of his purification,

3088.label: Leviticus 13:36
3088.text: the priest must then see him; and if the abnormal falling off of hair has spread in the skin, the priest need not make examination for yellow hair; he is unclean.

3089.label: Leviticus 13:37
3089.text: But if in its look the abnormal falling off of hair has stood and black hair has grown in it, the abnormal falling off of hair has been healed. He is clean, and the priest must pronounce him clean.

3090.label: Leviticus 13:38
3090.text: “As for a man or a woman, in case blotches develop in the skin of their flesh, white blotches,

3091.label: Leviticus 13:39
3091.text: the priest must then take a look; and if the blotches in the skin of their flesh are dull white, it is a harmless eruption. It has broken out in the skin. He is clean.

3092.label: Leviticus 13:40
3092.text: “As for a man, in case his head grows bald, it is baldness. He is clean.

3093.label: Leviticus 13:41
3093.text: And if his head grows bald up in front, it is forehead baldness. He is clean.

3094.label: Leviticus 13:42
3094.text: But in case a reddish-white plague develops in the baldness of the crown or of the forehead, it is leprosy breaking out in the baldness of his crown or of his forehead.

3095.label: Leviticus 13:43
3095.text: And the priest must look at him; and if there is an eruption of the reddish-white plague in the baldness of his crown or of his forehead like the appearance of leprosy in the skin of the flesh,

3096.label: Leviticus 13:44
3096.text: he is a leper. He is unclean. Unclean is what the priest should declare him. His plague is on his head.

3097.label: Leviticus 13:45
3097.text: As for the leprous one in whom the plague is, his garments should be torn, and his head should become ungroomed, and he should cover over the mustache and call out, ‘Unclean, unclean!’

3098.label: Leviticus 13:46
3098.text: All the days that the plague is in him he will be unclean. He is unclean. He should dwell isolated. Outside the camp is his dwelling place.

3099.label: Leviticus 13:47
3099.text: “As for a garment, in case the plague of leprosy develops in it, whether in a woolen garment or in a linen garment,

3100.label: Leviticus 13:48
3100.text: or in the warp or in the woof of the linen and of the wool, or in a skin or in anything made of skin,

3101.label: Leviticus 13:49
3101.text: and the yellowish-green or reddish plague does develop in the garment or in the skin or in the warp or in the woof or in any article of skin, it is the plague of leprosy, and it must be shown to the priest.

3102.label: Leviticus 13:50
3102.text: And the priest must see the plague, and he must quarantine the plague seven days.

3103.label: Leviticus 13:51
3103.text: When he has seen the plague on the seventh day, that the plague has spread in the garment or in the warp or in the woof or in the skin for any use for which the skin may be made, the plague is malignant leprosy. It is unclean.

3104.label: Leviticus 13:52
3104.text: And he must burn the garment or the warp or the woof in the wool or in the linen, or any article of skin in which the plague may develop, because it is malignant leprosy. It should be burned in the fire.

3105.label: Leviticus 13:53
3105.text: “But if the priest takes a look, and, there now, the plague has not spread in the garment or in the warp or in the woof or in any article of skin,

3106.label: Leviticus 13:54
3106.text: the priest must also command that they should wash that in which the plague is, and he must quarantine it a second seven days.

3107.label: Leviticus 13:55
3107.text: And the priest must look at the plague after it has been washed out, and if the plague has not changed its look and yet the plague has not spread, it is unclean. You should burn it in the fire. It is a low spot in a threadbare patch on either its underside or its outside.

3108.label: Leviticus 13:56
3108.text: “But if the priest has taken a look, and, there now, the plague is dull after it has been washed out, he must then tear it out of the garment or the skin or the warp or the woof.

3109.label: Leviticus 13:57
3109.text: However, if it still appears in the garment or in the warp or in the woof or in any article of skin, it is breaking out. You should burn in the fire whatever it is in which the plague is.

3110.label: Leviticus 13:58
3110.text: As for the garment or the warp or the woof or any article of skin that you may wash, when the plague has disappeared from them, it must then be washed a second time; and it must be clean.

3111.label: Leviticus 13:59
3111.text: “This is the law of the plague of leprosy in a garment of wool or of linen, or in the warp or in the woof, or in any article of skin, in order to pronounce it clean or to declare it unclean.”

3112.label: Leviticus 14:1
3112.text: And Jehovah continued to speak to Moses, saying:

3113.label: Leviticus 14:2
3113.text: “This will become the law of the leper in the day for establishing his purification, when he must be brought to the priest.

3114.label: Leviticus 14:3
3114.text: And the priest must go forth outside the camp, and the priest must look; and if the plague of leprosy has been cured in the leprous one,

3115.label: Leviticus 14:4
3115.text: the priest must then give command; and he must take for cleansing himself two live clean birds and cedarwood and coccus scarlet material and hyssop.

3116.label: Leviticus 14:5
3116.text: And the priest must give command, and the one bird must be killed in an earthenware vessel over running water.

3117.label: Leviticus 14:6
3117.text: As for the living bird, he should take it and the cedarwood and the coccus scarlet material and the hyssop, and he must dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird that was killed over the running water.

3118.label: Leviticus 14:7
3118.text: Then he must spatter it seven times upon the one cleansing himself from the leprosy and he must pronounce him clean, and he must send away the living bird over the open field.

3119.label: Leviticus 14:8
3119.text: “And the one cleansing himself must wash his garments and shave off all his hair and bathe in water and must be clean, and afterward he may come into the camp. And he must dwell outside his tent seven days.

3120.label: Leviticus 14:9
3120.text: And it must occur on the seventh day that he should shave off all his hair on his head and his chin and his eyebrows. Yes, he should shave off all his hair, and he must wash his garments and bathe his flesh in water; and he must be clean.

3121.label: Leviticus 14:10
3121.text: “And on the eighth day he will take two sound young rams and one sound female lamb, in its first year, and three tenths of an eʹphah of fine flour as a grain offering moistened with oil and one log measure of oil;

3122.label: Leviticus 14:11
3122.text: and the priest who pronounces him clean must present the man who is cleansing himself, and the things, before Jehovah at the entrance of the tent of meeting.

3123.label: Leviticus 14:12
3123.text: And the priest must take the one young ram and offer it for a guilt offering together with the log measure of oil and must wave them to and fro as a wave offering before Jehovah.

3124.label: Leviticus 14:13
3124.text: And he must slaughter the young ram in the place where the sin offering and the burnt offering are regularly slaughtered, in a holy place, because, like the sin offering, the guilt offering belongs to the priest. It is something most holy.

3125.label: Leviticus 14:14
3125.text: “And the priest must take some of the blood of the guilt offering, and the priest must put it upon the lobe of the right ear of the one cleansing himself and upon the thumb of his right hand and upon the big toe of his right foot.

3126.label: Leviticus 14:15
3126.text: And the priest must take some of the log measure of oil and pour it upon the priest’s left palm.

3127.label: Leviticus 14:16
3127.text: And the priest must dip his right finger into the oil that is upon his left palm and must spatter some of the oil with his finger seven times before Jehovah.

3128.label: Leviticus 14:17
3128.text: And of the rest of the oil that is upon his palm the priest will put some upon the lobe of the right ear of the one cleansing himself and upon the thumb of his right hand and upon the big toe of his right foot over the blood of the guilt offering.

3129.label: Leviticus 14:18
3129.text: And what is left over of the oil that is upon the priest’s palm he will put upon the head of the one cleansing himself, and the priest must make atonement for him before Jehovah.

3130.label: Leviticus 14:19
3130.text: “And the priest must render up the sin offering and make atonement for the one cleansing himself from his impurity, and afterward he will slaughter the burnt offering.

3131.label: Leviticus 14:20
3131.text: And the priest must offer up the burnt offering and the grain offering upon the altar, and the priest must make atonement for him; and he must be clean.

3132.label: Leviticus 14:21
3132.text: “However, if he is lowly and does not have enough means, he must then take one young ram as a guilt offering for a wave offering in order to make atonement for him and one tenth of an eʹphah of fine flour moistened with oil as a grain offering and a log measure of oil,

3133.label: Leviticus 14:22
3133.text: and two turtledoves or two young pigeons, according as he may have the means, and the one must serve as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering.

3134.label: Leviticus 14:23
3134.text: And on the eighth day he must bring them for establishing his purification to the priest at the entrance of the tent of meeting before Jehovah.

3135.label: Leviticus 14:24
3135.text: “And the priest must take the young ram of the guilt offering and the log measure of oil, and the priest must wave them to and fro as a wave offering before Jehovah.

3136.label: Leviticus 14:25
3136.text: And he must slaughter the young ram of the guilt offering, and the priest must take some of the blood of the guilt offering and put it upon the lobe of the right ear of the one cleansing himself and upon the thumb of his right hand and upon the big toe of his right foot.

3137.label: Leviticus 14:26
3137.text: And the priest will pour some of the oil upon the priest’s left palm.

3138.label: Leviticus 14:27
3138.text: And the priest must spatter with his right finger some of the oil that is upon his left palm seven times before Jehovah.

3139.label: Leviticus 14:28
3139.text: And the priest must put some of the oil that is on his palm upon the lobe of the right ear of the one cleansing himself and upon the thumb of his right hand and upon the big toe of his right foot over the place of the blood of the guilt offering.

3140.label: Leviticus 14:29
3140.text: And what is left over of the oil that is on the priest’s palm he will put upon the head of the one cleansing himself in order to make atonement for him before Jehovah.

3141.label: Leviticus 14:30
3141.text: “And he must render up the one of the turtledoves or of the young pigeons for which he may have the means,

3142.label: Leviticus 14:31
3142.text: the one of them for which he may have the means as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering along with the grain offering; and the priest must make atonement for the one cleansing himself before Jehovah.

3143.label: Leviticus 14:32
3143.text: “This is the law for the one in whom the plague of leprosy was who may not have the means when establishing his purification.”

3144.label: Leviticus 14:33
3144.text: And Jehovah proceeded to speak to Moses and Aaron, saying:

3145.label: Leviticus 14:34
3145.text: “When YOU come into the land of Caʹnaan, which I am giving YOU as a possession, and I do put the plague of leprosy in a house of the land of YOUR possession,

3146.label: Leviticus 14:35
