3146.text: the one to whom the house belongs must then come and tell the priest, saying, ‘Something like a plague has appeared to me in the house.’

3147.label: Leviticus 14:36
3147.text: And the priest must give orders, and they must clear out the house before the priest may come in to see the plague, that he may not declare unclean everything that is in the house; and after that the priest will come in to see the house.

3148.label: Leviticus 14:37
3148.text: When he has seen the plague, then if the plague is in the walls of the house, with yellowish-green or reddish depressions, and their appearance is lower than the wall surface,

3149.label: Leviticus 14:38
3149.text: the priest must then go out of the house to the entrance of the house and he must quarantine the house seven days.

3150.label: Leviticus 14:39
3150.text: “And the priest must return on the seventh day and must take a look; and if the plague has spread in the walls of the house,

3151.label: Leviticus 14:40
3151.text: the priest must then give orders, and they must tear out the stones in which the plague is, and they must throw them outside the city into an unclean place.

3152.label: Leviticus 14:41
3152.text: And he will have the house scraped off all around inside, and they must pour the clay mortar that they cut off outside the city into an unclean place.

3153.label: Leviticus 14:42
3153.text: And they must take other stones and insert them in the place of the former stones; and he will have different clay mortar taken, and he must have the house plastered.

3154.label: Leviticus 14:43
3154.text: “If, though, the plague returns and it does break out in the house after having torn out the stones and after having cut off the house and plastered it,

3155.label: Leviticus 14:44
3155.text: the priest must then come in and take a look; and if the plague has spread in the house, it is malignant leprosy in the house. It is unclean.

3156.label: Leviticus 14:45
3156.text: And he must have the house pulled down with its stones and its timbers and all the clay mortar of the house and must have it carried forth outside the city to an unclean place.

3157.label: Leviticus 14:46
3157.text: But whoever comes into the house any of the days of quarantining it will be unclean until the evening;

3158.label: Leviticus 14:47
3158.text: and whoever lies down in the house should wash his garments, and whoever eats in the house should wash his garments.

3159.label: Leviticus 14:48
3159.text: “However, if the priest comes at all and he does take a look, and, there now, the plague has not spread in the house after having plastered the house, the priest must then pronounce the house clean, because the plague has been healed.

3160.label: Leviticus 14:49
3160.text: And to purify the house from sin he must take two birds and cedarwood and coccus scarlet material and hyssop.

3161.label: Leviticus 14:50
3161.text: And he must kill the one bird in an earthenware vessel over running water.

3162.label: Leviticus 14:51
3162.text: And he must take the cedarwood and the hyssop and the coccus scarlet material and the live bird and dip them in the blood of the bird that was killed and in the running water, and he must spatter it toward the house seven times.

3163.label: Leviticus 14:52
3163.text: And he must purify the house from sin with the blood of the bird and the running water and the live bird and the cedarwood and the hyssop and the coccus scarlet material.

3164.label: Leviticus 14:53
3164.text: And he must send the live bird away outside the city into the open field and must make atonement for the house; and it must be clean.

3165.label: Leviticus 14:54
3165.text: “This is the law respecting any plague of leprosy and respecting the abnormal falling off of hair

3166.label: Leviticus 14:55
3166.text: and respecting the leprosy of the garment and in the house,

3167.label: Leviticus 14:56
3167.text: and respecting the eruption and the scab and the blotch,

3168.label: Leviticus 14:57
3168.text: in order to give instructions when something is unclean and when something is clean. This is the law about leprosy.”

3169.label: Leviticus 15:1
3169.text: And Jehovah continued to speak to Moses and Aaron, saying:

3170.label: Leviticus 15:2
3170.text: “Speak to the sons of Israel, and YOU must say to them, ‘In case any man has a running discharge occur from his genital organ, his discharge is unclean.

3171.label: Leviticus 15:3
3171.text: And this will become his uncleanness by his discharge: Whether his genital organ has flowed with a running discharge or his genital organ is obstructed from his running discharge, it is his uncleanness.

3172.label: Leviticus 15:4
3172.text: “‘Any bed upon which the one having a running discharge may lie down will be unclean, and any article upon which he may sit will be unclean.

3173.label: Leviticus 15:5
3173.text: And a man who may touch his bed should wash his garments, and he must bathe in water and be unclean until the evening.

3174.label: Leviticus 15:6
3174.text: And whoever sits upon the article upon which the one having a running discharge was sitting should wash his garments, and he must bathe in water and be unclean until the evening.

3175.label: Leviticus 15:7
3175.text: And whoever touches the flesh of the one having a running discharge should wash his garments, and he must bathe in water and be unclean until the evening.

3176.label: Leviticus 15:8
3176.text: And in the case of the one who has a running discharge spitting upon someone clean, he must in that case wash his garments and bathe in water and be unclean until the evening.

3177.label: Leviticus 15:9
3177.text: And any saddle upon which the one having a running discharge was riding will be unclean.

3178.label: Leviticus 15:10
3178.text: And anyone touching anything that happens to be under him will be unclean until the evening; and he who carries them will wash his garments, and he must bathe in water and be unclean until the evening.

3179.label: Leviticus 15:11
3179.text: And anyone whom the one having a running discharge might touch when he has not rinsed his hands in water must then wash his garments and bathe in water and be unclean until the evening.

3180.label: Leviticus 15:12
3180.text: And an earthenware vessel that the one having a running discharge might touch should be smashed; and any wooden vessel should be rinsed with water.

3181.label: Leviticus 15:13
3181.text: “‘Now in case the one having a running discharge would become clean from his running discharge, he must then count for himself seven days for his purification, and he must wash his garments and bathe his flesh in running water; and he must be clean.

3182.label: Leviticus 15:14
3182.text: And on the eighth day he should take for himself two turtledoves or two young pigeons, and he must come before Jehovah to the entrance of the tent of meeting and give them to the priest.

3183.label: Leviticus 15:15
3183.text: And the priest must offer them, the one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering; and the priest must make atonement for him before Jehovah concerning his running discharge.

3184.label: Leviticus 15:16
3184.text: “‘Now in case a man has an emission of semen go out from him, he must then bathe all his flesh in water and be unclean until the evening.

3185.label: Leviticus 15:17
3185.text: And any garment and any skin upon which the emission of semen gets to be must be washed with water and be unclean until the evening.

3186.label: Leviticus 15:18
3186.text: “‘As for a woman with whom a man may lie down with an emission of semen, they must bathe in water and be unclean until the evening.

3187.label: Leviticus 15:19
3187.text: “‘And in case a woman is having a running discharge, and her running discharge in her flesh proves to be blood, she should continue seven days in her menstrual impurity, and anyone touching her will be unclean until the evening.

3188.label: Leviticus 15:20
3188.text: And anything upon which she may lie down in her menstrual impurity will be unclean, and everything upon which she may sit will be unclean.

3189.label: Leviticus 15:21
3189.text: And anyone touching her bed should wash his garments, and he must bathe in water and be unclean until the evening.

3190.label: Leviticus 15:22
3190.text: And anyone touching any article upon which she was sitting should wash his garments, and he must bathe in water and be unclean until the evening.

3191.label: Leviticus 15:23
3191.text: And if it was upon the bed or upon another article that she was sitting, by his touching it he will be unclean until the evening.

3192.label: Leviticus 15:24
3192.text: And if a man lies down with her at all and her menstrual impurity comes to be upon him, he must then be unclean seven days, and any bed upon which he might lie down will be unclean.

3193.label: Leviticus 15:25
3193.text: “‘As for a woman, in case the running discharge of her blood should be flowing many days when it is not the regular time of her menstrual impurity, or in case she should have a flow longer than her menstrual impurity, all the days of her unclean running discharge will prove as in the days of her menstrual impurity. She is unclean.

3194.label: Leviticus 15:26
3194.text: Any bed upon which she may lie any of the days of her running discharge will become for her as the bed of her menstrual impurity, and any article upon which she may sit will become unclean like the uncleanness of her menstrual impurity.

3195.label: Leviticus 15:27
3195.text: And anyone touching them will be unclean, and he must wash his garments and bathe in water and be unclean until the evening.

3196.label: Leviticus 15:28
3196.text: “‘However, if she has become clean from her running discharge, she must also count for herself seven days, and afterward she will be clean.

3197.label: Leviticus 15:29
3197.text: And on the eighth day she should take for herself two turtledoves or two young pigeons, and she must bring them to the priest at the entrance of the tent of meeting.

3198.label: Leviticus 15:30
3198.text: And the priest must make the one a sin offering and the other a burnt offering; and the priest must make atonement for her before Jehovah concerning her unclean running discharge.

3199.label: Leviticus 15:31
3199.text: “‘And YOU must keep the sons of Israel separate from their uncleanness, that they may not die in their uncleanness for their defiling of my tabernacle, which is in their midst.

3200.label: Leviticus 15:32
3200.text: “‘This is the law about the man having a running discharge and the man from whom an emission of semen may go out so that he becomes unclean by it;

3201.label: Leviticus 15:33
3201.text: and the menstruating woman in her uncleanness, and anyone who has a flow of his running discharge, whether a male or a female, and whether a man who lies down with an unclean woman.’”

3202.label: Leviticus 16:1
3202.text: And Jehovah proceeded to speak to Moses after the death of Aaron’s two sons for their approaching before Jehovah so that they died.

3203.label: Leviticus 16:2
3203.text: And Jehovah proceeded to say to Moses: “Speak to Aaron your brother, that he should not at all times come into the holy place inside the curtain, in front of the cover which is upon the Ark, that he may not die; because in a cloud I shall appear over the cover.

3204.label: Leviticus 16:3
3204.text: “With the following Aaron should come into the holy place: with a young bull for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering.

3205.label: Leviticus 16:4
3205.text: He should put on the holy linen robe, and the linen drawers should come upon his flesh, and he should gird himself with the linen sash and wrap himself with the linen turban. They are holy garments. And he must bathe his flesh in water and put them on.

3206.label: Leviticus 16:5
3206.text: “And from the assembly of the sons of Israel he should take two male kids of the goats for a sin offering and one ram for a burnt offering.

3207.label: Leviticus 16:6
3207.text: “And Aaron must present the bull of the sin offering, which is for himself, and he must make atonement in behalf of himself and his house.

3208.label: Leviticus 16:7
3208.text: “And he must take the two goats and make them stand before Jehovah at the entrance of the tent of meeting.

3209.label: Leviticus 16:8
3209.text: And Aaron must draw lots over the two goats, the one lot for Jehovah and the other lot for A·zaʹzel.

3210.label: Leviticus 16:9
3210.text: And Aaron must present the goat over which the lot came up for Jehovah, and he must make it a sin offering.

3211.label: Leviticus 16:10
3211.text: But the goat over which the lot came up for A·zaʹzel should be stood alive before Jehovah to make atonement for it, so as to send it away for A·zaʹzel into the wilderness.

3212.label: Leviticus 16:11
3212.text: “And Aaron must present the bull of the sin offering, which is for himself, and make an atonement in behalf of himself and his house; and he must slaughter the bull of the sin offering, which is for himself.

3213.label: Leviticus 16:12
3213.text: “And he must take the fire holder full of burning coals of fire from off the altar before Jehovah, and the hollows of both his hands full of fine perfumed incense, and he must bring them inside the curtain.

3214.label: Leviticus 16:13
3214.text: He must also put the incense upon the fire before Jehovah, and the cloud of the incense must overspread the Ark cover, which is upon the Testimony, that he may not die.

3215.label: Leviticus 16:14
3215.text: “And he must take some of the bull’s blood and spatter it with his finger in front of the cover on the east side, and he will spatter some of the blood with his finger seven times before the cover.

3216.label: Leviticus 16:15
3216.text: “And he must slaughter the goat of the sin offering, which is for the people, and he must bring its blood inside the curtain and do with its blood the same as he did with the bull’s blood; and he must spatter it toward the cover and before the cover.

3217.label: Leviticus 16:16
3217.text: “And he must make atonement for the holy place concerning the uncleannesses of the sons of Israel and concerning their revolts in all their sins; and that is the way he should do for the tent of meeting, which is residing with them in the midst of their uncleannesses.

3218.label: Leviticus 16:17
3218.text: “And no other man should happen to be in the tent of meeting from when he goes in to make atonement in the holy place until he comes out; and he must make atonement in behalf of himself and in behalf of his house and in behalf of the entire congregation of Israel.

3219.label: Leviticus 16:18
3219.text: “And he must come out to the altar, which is before Jehovah, and make atonement for it, and he must take some of the bull’s blood and some of the goat’s blood and put it upon the horns of the altar round about.

3220.label: Leviticus 16:19
3220.text: He must also spatter some of the blood upon it with his finger seven times and cleanse it and sanctify it from the uncleannesses of the sons of Israel.

3221.label: Leviticus 16:20
3221.text: “When he has finished making atonement for the holy place and the tent of meeting and the altar, he must also present the live goat.

3222.label: Leviticus 16:21
3222.text: And Aaron must lay both his hands upon the head of the live goat and confess over it all the errors of the sons of Israel and all their revolts in all their sins, and he must put them upon the head of the goat and send it away by the hand of a ready man into the wilderness.

3223.label: Leviticus 16:22
3223.text: And the goat must carry upon itself all their errors into a desert land, and he must send the goat away into the wilderness.

3224.label: Leviticus 16:23
3224.text: “And Aaron must come into the tent of meeting and strip off the linen garments that he put on when he went into the holy place, and he must lay them down there.

3225.label: Leviticus 16:24
3225.text: And he must bathe his flesh in water in a holy place and put on his garments and come out and render up his burnt offering and the people’s burnt offering and make atonement in his own behalf and in behalf of the people.

3226.label: Leviticus 16:25
3226.text: And he will make the fat of the sin offering smoke upon the altar.

3227.label: Leviticus 16:26
3227.text: “As for the one who sent the goat away for A·zaʹzel, he should wash his garments, and he must bathe his flesh in water, and after that he may come into the camp.

3228.label: Leviticus 16:27
3228.text: “However, he will have the bull of the sin offering and the goat of the sin offering, the blood of both of which was brought in to make atonement in the holy place, taken forth outside the camp; and they must burn their skins and their flesh and their dung in the fire.

3229.label: Leviticus 16:28
3229.text: And the one who burned them should wash his garments, and he must bathe his flesh in water, and after that he may come into the camp.

3230.label: Leviticus 16:29
3230.text: “And it must serve as a statute to time indefinite for YOU people: In the seventh month on the tenth of the month YOU should afflict YOUR souls, and YOU must not do any work, either the native or the alien resident who is residing as an alien in YOUR midst.

3231.label: Leviticus 16:30
3231.text: For on this day atonement will be made for YOU to pronounce YOU clean. YOU will be clean from all YOUR sins before Jehovah.

3232.label: Leviticus 16:31
3232.text: It is a sabbath of complete rest for YOU, and YOU must afflict YOUR souls. It is a statute to time indefinite.

3233.label: Leviticus 16:32
3233.text: “And the priest who will be anointed and whose hand will be filled with power to act as priest as successor of his father must make an atonement and must put on the linen garments. They are holy garments.

3234.label: Leviticus 16:33
3234.text: And he must make atonement for the holy sanctuary, and for the tent of meeting and for the altar he will make atonement; and for the priests and for all the people of the congregation he will make atonement.

3235.label: Leviticus 16:34
3235.text: And this must serve as a statute to time indefinite for YOU, in order to make atonement for the sons of Israel concerning all their sins once in the year.” Accordingly he did just as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

3236.label: Leviticus 17:1
3236.text: And Jehovah went on to speak to Moses, saying:

3237.label: Leviticus 17:2
3237.text: “Speak to Aaron and his sons and all the sons of Israel, and you must say to them, ‘This is the thing that Jehovah has commanded, saying:

3238.label: Leviticus 17:3
3238.text: “‘“As for any man of the house of Israel who slaughters a bull or a young ram or a goat in the camp or who slaughters it outside the camp

3239.label: Leviticus 17:4
3239.text: and does not actually bring it to the entrance of the tent of meeting to present it as an offering to Jehovah before the tabernacle of Jehovah, bloodguilt will be counted to that man. He has shed blood, and that man must be cut off from among his people,

3240.label: Leviticus 17:5
3240.text: in order that the sons of Israel may bring their sacrifices, which they are sacrificing in the open field, and they must bring them to Jehovah to the entrance of the tent of meeting to the priest, and they must sacrifice these as communion sacrifices to Jehovah.

3241.label: Leviticus 17:6
3241.text: And the priest must sprinkle the blood upon Jehovah’s altar at the entrance of the tent of meeting, and he must make the fat smoke as a restful odor to Jehovah.

3242.label: Leviticus 17:7
3242.text: So they should no longer sacrifice their sacrifices to the goat-shaped demons with which they are having immoral intercourse. This will serve as a statute to time indefinite for YOU, throughout YOUR generations.”’

3243.label: Leviticus 17:8
3243.text: “And you should say to them, ‘As for any man of the house of Israel or some alien resident who may be residing as an alien in YOUR midst who offers up a burnt offering or a sacrifice

3244.label: Leviticus 17:9
3244.text: and does not bring it to the entrance of the tent of meeting to render it to Jehovah, that man must be cut off from his people.

3245.label: Leviticus 17:10
3245.text: “‘As for any man of the house of Israel or some alien resident who is residing as an alien in YOUR midst who eats any sort of blood, I shall certainly set my face against the soul that is eating the blood, and I shall indeed cut him off from among his people.

3246.label: Leviticus 17:11
3246.text: For the soul of the flesh is in the blood, and I myself have put it upon the altar for YOU to make atonement for YOUR souls, because it is the blood that makes atonement by the soul [in it].

3247.label: Leviticus 17:12
3247.text: That is why I have said to the sons of Israel: “No soul of YOU must eat blood and no alien resident who is residing as an alien in YOUR midst should eat blood.”

3248.label: Leviticus 17:13
3248.text: “‘As for any man of the sons of Israel or some alien resident who is residing as an alien in YOUR midst who in hunting catches a wild beast or a fowl that may be eaten, he must in that case pour its blood out and cover it with dust.

3249.label: Leviticus 17:14
3249.text: For the soul of every sort of flesh is its blood by the soul in it. Consequently I said to the sons of Israel: “YOU must not eat the blood of any sort of flesh, because the soul of every sort of flesh is its blood. Anyone eating it will be cut off.”

3250.label: Leviticus 17:15
3250.text: As for any soul that eats a body [already] dead or something torn by a wild beast, whether a native or an alien resident, he must in that case wash his garments and bathe in water and be unclean until the evening; and he must be clean.

3251.label: Leviticus 17:16
3251.text: But if he will not wash them and will not bathe his flesh, he must then answer for his error.’”

3252.label: Leviticus 18:1
3252.text: And Jehovah continued to speak to Moses, saying:

3253.label: Leviticus 18:2
3253.text: “Speak to the sons of Israel, and you must say to them, ‘I am Jehovah YOUR God.

3254.label: Leviticus 18:3
3254.text: The way the land of Egypt does, in which YOU dwelt, YOU must not do; and the way the land of Caʹnaan does, into which I am bringing YOU, YOU must not do; and in their statutes YOU must not walk.

3255.label: Leviticus 18:4
3255.text: My judicial decisions YOU should carry out, and my statutes YOU should keep so as to walk in them. I am Jehovah YOUR God.

3256.label: Leviticus 18:5
3256.text: And YOU must keep my statutes and my judicial decisions, which if a man will do, he must also live by means of them. I am Jehovah.

3257.label: Leviticus 18:6
3257.text: “‘YOU people must not come near, any man of YOU, to any close fleshly relative of his to lay bare nakedness. I am Jehovah.

3258.label: Leviticus 18:7
3258.text: The nakedness of your father and the nakedness of your mother you must not lay bare. She is your mother. You must not lay bare her nakedness.

3259.label: Leviticus 18:8
3259.text: “‘The nakedness of your father’s wife you must not lay bare. It is your father’s nakedness.

3260.label: Leviticus 18:9
3260.text: “‘As for the nakedness of your sister, the daughter of your father or the daughter of your mother, whether born in the same household or born outside it, you must not lay bare their nakedness.

3261.label: Leviticus 18:10
3261.text: “‘As for the nakedness of the daughter of your son or the daughter of your daughter, you must not lay bare their nakedness, because they are your nakedness.

3262.label: Leviticus 18:11
3262.text: “‘As for the nakedness of the daughter of your father’s wife, the offspring of your father, she being your sister, you must not lay bare her nakedness.

3263.label: Leviticus 18:12
3263.text: “‘The nakedness of your father’s sister you must not lay bare. She is the blood relation of your father.

3264.label: Leviticus 18:13
3264.text: “‘The nakedness of your mother’s sister you must not lay bare, because she is a blood relation of your mother.

3265.label: Leviticus 18:14
3265.text: “‘The nakedness of your father’s brother you must not lay bare. You must not come near his wife. She is your aunt.

3266.label: Leviticus 18:15
3266.text: “‘The nakedness of your daughter-in-law you must not lay bare. She is your son’s wife. You must not lay her nakedness bare.

3267.label: Leviticus 18:16
3267.text: “‘The nakedness of your brother’s wife you must not lay bare. It is your brother’s nakedness.

3268.label: Leviticus 18:17
3268.text: “‘The nakedness of a woman and her daughter you must not lay bare. The daughter of her son and the daughter of her daughter you must not take in order to lay her nakedness bare. They are cases of blood relationship. It is loose conduct.

3269.label: Leviticus 18:18
3269.text: “‘And you must not take a woman in addition to her sister as a rival to uncover her nakedness, that is, besides her during her lifetime.

3270.label: Leviticus 18:19
3270.text: “‘And you must not come near a woman during the menstruation of her impurity to lay her nakedness bare.

3271.label: Leviticus 18:20
3271.text: “‘And you must not give your emission as semen to the wife of your associate to become unclean by it.

3272.label: Leviticus 18:21
3272.text: “‘And you must not allow the devoting of any of your offspring to Moʹlech. You must not profane the name of your God that way. I am Jehovah.

3273.label: Leviticus 18:22
3273.text: “‘And you must not lie down with a male the same as you lie down with a woman. It is a detestable thing.

3274.label: Leviticus 18:23
3274.text: “‘And you must not give your emission to any beast to become unclean by it, and a woman should not stand before a beast to have connection with it. It is a violation of what is natural.

3275.label: Leviticus 18:24
3275.text: “‘Do not make yourselves unclean by any of these things, because by all these things the nations whom I am sending out from before YOU have made themselves unclean.

3276.label: Leviticus 18:25
3276.text: Consequently the land is unclean, and I shall bring punishment for its error upon it, and the land will vomit its inhabitants out.

3277.label: Leviticus 18:26
3277.text: And YOU yourselves must keep my statutes and my judicial decisions, and YOU must not do any of all these detestable things, whether a native or an alien resident who is residing as an alien in YOUR midst.

3278.label: Leviticus 18:27
3278.text: For all these detestable things the men of the land who were before YOU have done, so that the land is unclean.

3279.label: Leviticus 18:28
3279.text: Then the land will not vomit YOU out for YOUR defiling it the same way as it will certainly vomit the nations out who were before YOU.

3280.label: Leviticus 18:29
3280.text: In case anyone does any of all these detestable things, then the souls doing them must be cut off from among their people.

3281.label: Leviticus 18:30
3281.text: And YOU must keep YOUR obligation to me not to carry on any of the detestable customs that have been carried on before YOU, that YOU may not make yourselves unclean by them. I am Jehovah YOUR God.’”

3282.label: Leviticus 19:1
3282.text: And Jehovah spoke further to Moses, saying:

3283.label: Leviticus 19:2
3283.text: “Speak to the entire assembly of the sons of Israel, and you must say to them, ‘YOU should prove yourselves holy, because I Jehovah YOUR God am holy.

3284.label: Leviticus 19:3
3284.text: “‘YOU should fear each one his mother and his father, and my sabbaths YOU should keep. I am Jehovah YOUR God.

3285.label: Leviticus 19:4
3285.text: Do not turn yourselves to valueless gods, and YOU must not make molten gods for yourselves. I am Jehovah YOUR God.

3286.label: Leviticus 19:5
3286.text: “‘Now in case YOU should sacrifice a communion sacrifice to Jehovah, YOU should sacrifice it to gain approval for yourselves.

3287.label: Leviticus 19:6
3287.text: On the day of YOUR sacrifice and directly the next day it should be eaten, but what is left over till the third day should be burned in the fire.

3288.label: Leviticus 19:7
3288.text: If, though, it should at all be eaten on the third day, it is a foul thing. It will not be accepted with approval.

3289.label: Leviticus 19:8
3289.text: And the one eating it will answer for his error, because he has profaned a holy thing of Jehovah; and that soul must be cut off from his people.

3290.label: Leviticus 19:9
3290.text: “‘And when YOU people reap the harvest of YOUR land, you must not reap the edge of your field completely, and the gleaning of your harvest you must not pick up.

3291.label: Leviticus 19:10
3291.text: Also, you must not gather the leftovers of your vineyard, and you must not pick up the scattered grapes of your vineyard. For the afflicted one and the alien resident you should leave them. I am Jehovah YOUR God.

3292.label: Leviticus 19:11
3292.text: “‘YOU people must not steal, and YOU must not deceive, and YOU must not deal falsely anyone with his associate.

3293.label: Leviticus 19:12
3293.text: And YOU must not swear in my name to a lie, so that you do profane the name of your God. I am Jehovah.

3294.label: Leviticus 19:13
3294.text: You must not defraud your fellow, and you must not rob. The wages of a hired laborer should not stay all night with you until morning.

3295.label: Leviticus 19:14
3295.text: “‘You must not call down evil upon a deaf man, and before a blind man you must not put an obstacle; and you must be in fear of your God. I am Jehovah.

3296.label: Leviticus 19:15
3296.text: “‘YOU people must not do injustice in the judgment. You must not treat the lowly with partiality, and you must not prefer the person of a great one. With justice you should judge your associate.

3297.label: Leviticus 19:16
3297.text: “‘You must not go around among your people for the sake of slandering. You must not stand up against your fellow’s blood. I am Jehovah.

3298.label: Leviticus 19:17
3298.text: “‘You must not hate your brother in your heart. You should by all means reprove your associate, that you may not bear sin along with him.

3299.label: Leviticus 19:18
3299.text: “‘You must not take vengeance nor have a grudge against the sons of your people; and you must love your fellow as yourself. I am Jehovah.

3300.label: Leviticus 19:19
3300.text: “‘YOU people should keep my statutes: You must not interbreed your domestic animals of two sorts. You must not sow your field with seeds of two sorts, and you must not put upon yourself a garment of two sorts of thread, mixed together.

3301.label: Leviticus 19:20
3301.text: “‘Now in case a man lies down with a woman and has an emission of semen, when she is a maidservant designated for another man, and she has not in any way been redeemed nor has freedom been given her, punishment should take place. They should not be put to death, because she was not set free.

3302.label: Leviticus 19:21
3302.text: And he must bring his guilt offering to Jehovah to the entrance of the tent of meeting, a ram of guilt offering.

3303.label: Leviticus 19:22
3303.text: And the priest must make atonement for him with the ram of the guilt offering before Jehovah for his sin that he committed; and his sin that he committed must be forgiven him.

3304.label: Leviticus 19:23
3304.text: “‘And in case YOU people come into the land, and YOU must plant any tree for food, YOU must also consider its fruitage impure as its “foreskin.” For three years it will continue uncircumcised for YOU. It should not be eaten.

3305.label: Leviticus 19:24
3305.text: But in the fourth year all its fruit will become a holy thing of festal exultation to Jehovah.

3306.label: Leviticus 19:25
3306.text: And in the fifth year YOU may eat its fruit in order to add its produce to yourselves. I am Jehovah YOUR God.

3307.label: Leviticus 19:26
3307.text: “‘YOU must eat nothing along with blood. “‘YOU must not look for omens, and YOU must not practice magic.

3308.label: Leviticus 19:27
3308.text: “‘YOU must not cut YOUR sidelocks short around, and you must not destroy the extremity of your beard.

3309.label: Leviticus 19:28
3309.text: “‘And YOU must not make cuts in YOUR flesh for a deceased soul, and YOU must not put tattoo marking upon yourselves. I am Jehovah.

3310.label: Leviticus 19:29
3310.text: “‘Do not profane your daughter by making her a prostitute, in order that the land may not commit prostitution and the land actually be filled with loose morals.

3311.label: Leviticus 19:30
3311.text: “‘My sabbaths YOU should keep, and YOU should stand in awe of my sanctuary. I am Jehovah.

3312.label: Leviticus 19:31
3312.text: “‘Do not turn yourselves to the spirit mediums, and do not consult professional foretellers of events, so as to become unclean by them. I am Jehovah YOUR God.

3313.label: Leviticus 19:32
3313.text: “‘Before gray hair you should rise up, and you must show consideration for the person of an old man, and you must be in fear of your God. I am Jehovah.

3314.label: Leviticus 19:33
3314.text: “‘And in case an alien resident resides with you as an alien in YOUR land, YOU must not mistreat him.

3315.label: Leviticus 19:34
3315.text: The alien resident who resides as an alien with YOU should become to YOU like a native of YOURS; and you must love him as yourself, for YOU became alien residents in the land of Egypt. I am Jehovah YOUR God.

3316.label: Leviticus 19:35
3316.text: “‘YOU must not commit injustice in judging, in measuring, in weighing or in measuring liquids.

3317.label: Leviticus 19:36
3317.text: YOU should prove to have accurate scales, accurate weights, an accurate eʹphah and an accurate hin. Jehovah YOUR God I am, who have brought YOU out of the land of Egypt.

3318.label: Leviticus 19:37
3318.text: So YOU must keep all my statutes and all my judicial decisions, and YOU must do them. I am Jehovah.’”

3319.label: Leviticus 20:1
3319.text: And Jehovah went on speaking to Moses, saying:

3320.label: Leviticus 20:2
3320.text: “You are to say to the sons of Israel, ‘Any man of the sons of Israel, and any alien resident who resides as an alien in Israel, who gives any of his offspring to Moʹlech, should be put to death without fail. The people of the land should pelt him to death with stones.

3321.label: Leviticus 20:3
3321.text: And as for me, I shall set my face against that man, and I will cut him off from among his people, because he has given some of his offspring to Moʹlech for the purpose of defiling my holy place and to profane my holy name.

3322.label: Leviticus 20:4
3322.text: And if the people of the land should deliberately hide their eyes from that man when he gives any of his offspring to Moʹlech by not putting him to death,

3323.label: Leviticus 20:5
3323.text: then I, for my part, shall certainly fix my face against that man and his family, and I shall indeed cut him and all those who have immoral intercourse along with him in having immoral intercourse with Moʹlech off from among their people.

3324.label: Leviticus 20:6
3324.text: “‘As for the soul who turns himself to the spirit mediums and the professional foretellers of events so as to have immoral intercourse with them, I shall certainly set my face against that soul and cut him off from among his people.

3325.label: Leviticus 20:7
3325.text: “‘And YOU must sanctify yourselves and prove yourselves holy, because I am Jehovah YOUR God.

3326.label: Leviticus 20:8
3326.text: And YOU must keep my statutes and do them. I am Jehovah who is sanctifying YOU.

3327.label: Leviticus 20:9
3327.text: “‘In case there should be any man who calls down evil upon his father and his mother, he should be put to death without fail. It is his father and his mother upon whom he has called down evil. His own blood is upon him.

3328.label: Leviticus 20:10
3328.text: “‘Now a man who commits adultery with another man’s wife is one who commits adultery with the wife of his fellowman. He should be put to death without fail, the adulterer and the adulteress as well.

3329.label: Leviticus 20:11
3329.text: And a man who lies down with his father’s wife has laid bare the nakedness of his father. Both of them should be put to death without fail. Their own blood is upon them.

3330.label: Leviticus 20:12
3330.text: And where a man lies down with his daughter-in-law, both of them should be put to death without fail. They have committed a violation of what is natural. Their own blood is upon them.

3331.label: Leviticus 20:13
3331.text: “‘And when a man lies down with a male the same as one lies down with a woman, both of them have done a detestable thing. They should be put to death without fail. Their own blood is upon them.

3332.label: Leviticus 20:14
3332.text: “‘And where a man takes a woman and her mother, it is loose conduct. They should burn him and them in the fire, in order that loose conduct may not continue in YOUR midst.

3333.label: Leviticus 20:15
3333.text: “‘And where a man gives his seminal emission to a beast, he should be put to death without fail, and YOU should kill the beast.

3334.label: Leviticus 20:16
3334.text: And where a woman approaches any beast to have a connection with it, you must kill the woman and the beast. They should be put to death without fail. Their own blood is upon them.

3335.label: Leviticus 20:17
3335.text: “‘And where a man takes his sister, the daughter of his father or the daughter of his mother, and he does see her nakedness, and she herself sees his nakedness, it is shame. So they must be cut off before the eyes of the sons of their people. It is the nakedness of his sister that he has laid bare. He should answer for his error.

3336.label: Leviticus 20:18
3336.text: “‘And where a man lies down with a menstruating woman and does lay bare her nakedness, he has exposed her source, and she herself has laid bare the source of her blood. So both of them must be cut off from among their people.

3337.label: Leviticus 20:19
3337.text: “‘And the nakedness of your mother’s sister and of your father’s sister you must not lay bare, because it is his blood relation that one has exposed. They should answer for their error.

3338.label: Leviticus 20:20
3338.text: And a man who lies down with his uncle’s wife has laid bare the nakedness of his uncle. They should answer for their sin. They should die childless.

3339.label: Leviticus 20:21
3339.text: And where a man takes his brother’s wife, it is something abhorrent. It is the nakedness of his brother that he has laid bare. They should become childless.

3340.label: Leviticus 20:22
3340.text: “‘And YOU people must keep all my statutes and all my judicial decisions and do them, that the land to which I am bringing YOU to dwell in it may not vomit YOU out.

3341.label: Leviticus 20:23
3341.text: And YOU must not walk in the statutes of the nations whom I am sending out from before YOU, because they have done all these things and I abhor them.

3342.label: Leviticus 20:24
3342.text: Hence I said to YOU: “YOU, for YOUR part, will take possession of their ground, and I, for my part, shall give it to YOU to take possession of it, a land flowing with milk and honey. Jehovah YOUR God I am, who have divided YOU off from the peoples.”

3343.label: Leviticus 20:25
3343.text: And YOU must make a distinction between the clean beast and the unclean and between the unclean fowl and the clean; and YOU must not make YOUR souls loathsome with the beast and the fowl and anything that moves on the ground that I have divided off for YOU in declaring them unclean.

3344.label: Leviticus 20:26
3344.text: And YOU must prove yourselves holy to me, because I Jehovah am holy; and I am proceeding to divide YOU off from the peoples to become mine.

3345.label: Leviticus 20:27
3345.text: “‘And as for a man or woman in whom there proves to be a mediumistic spirit or spirit of prediction, they should be put to death without fail. They should pelt them to death with stones. Their own blood is upon them.’”

3346.label: Leviticus 21:1
3346.text: And Jehovah went on to say to Moses: “Talk to the priests, Aaron’s sons, and you must say to them, ‘For a deceased soul no one may defile himself among his people.

3347.label: Leviticus 21:2
3347.text: But for a blood relation of his who is close to him, for his mother and for his father and for his son and for his daughter and for his brother

3348.label: Leviticus 21:3
3348.text: and for his sister, a virgin who is close to him, who has not become a man’s, for her he may defile himself.

3349.label: Leviticus 21:4
3349.text: He may not defile himself for a woman possessed by an owner among his people so as to make himself profane.

3350.label: Leviticus 21:5
3350.text: They should not produce baldness upon their heads, and the extremity of their beard they should not shave, and on their flesh they should not make an incision.

3351.label: Leviticus 21:6
3351.text: They should prove themselves holy to their God, and they should not profane the name of their God, because they are those presenting Jehovah’s offerings made by fire, the bread of their God; and they must prove themselves holy.

3352.label: Leviticus 21:7
3352.text: A prostitute or a violated woman they should not take; and a woman divorced from her husband they should not take, because he is holy to his God.

3353.label: Leviticus 21:8
3353.text: So you must sanctify him, because he is one presenting the bread of your God. He should prove to be holy to you, because I Jehovah, who am sanctifying YOU, am holy.

3354.label: Leviticus 21:9
3354.text: “‘Now in case the daughter of a priest should make herself profane by committing prostitution, it is her father that she is profaning. She should be burned in the fire.

3355.label: Leviticus 21:10
3355.text: “‘And as for the high priest of his brothers upon whose head the anointing oil would be poured and whose hand was filled with power to wear the garments, he should not let his head go ungroomed, and he should not tear his garments.

3356.label: Leviticus 21:11
3356.text: And he should not come to any dead soul. For his father and his mother he may not defile himself.

3357.label: Leviticus 21:12
3357.text: He should also not go out from the sanctuary and not profane the sanctuary of his God, because the sign of dedication, the anointing oil of his God, is upon him. I am Jehovah.

3358.label: Leviticus 21:13
3358.text: “‘And for his part, he should take a woman in her virginity.

3359.label: Leviticus 21:14
3359.text: As for a widow or a divorced woman and one violated, a prostitute, none of these may he take, but he should take a virgin from his people as a wife.

3360.label: Leviticus 21:15
3360.text: And he should not profane his seed among his people, because I am Jehovah who is sanctifying him.’”

3361.label: Leviticus 21:16
3361.text: And Jehovah continued to speak to Moses, saying:

3362.label: Leviticus 21:17
3362.text: “Speak to Aaron, saying, ‘No man of your seed throughout their generations in whom there proves to be a defect may come near to present the bread of his God.

3363.label: Leviticus 21:18
3363.text: In case there is any man in whom there is a defect, he may not come near: a man blind or lame or with his nose slit or with one member too long,

3364.label: Leviticus 21:19
3364.text: or a man in whom there proves to be a fracture of the foot or a fracture of the hand,

3365.label: Leviticus 21:20
3365.text: or hunchback or thin or diseased in his eyes or scabby or having ringworms or having his testicles broken.

3366.label: Leviticus 21:21
3366.text: Any man of the seed of Aaron the priest in whom there is a defect may not approach to present Jehovah’s offerings made by fire. There is a defect in him. He may not approach to present the bread of his God.

3367.label: Leviticus 21:22
3367.text: He may eat the bread of his God from the most holy things and from the holy things.

3368.label: Leviticus 21:23
3368.text: However, he may not come in near the curtain, and he may not approach the altar, because there is a defect in him; and he should not profane my sanctuary, for I am Jehovah who is sanctifying them.’”

3369.label: Leviticus 21:24
3369.text: Accordingly Moses spoke to Aaron and his sons and all the sons of Israel.

3370.label: Leviticus 22:1
3370.text: And Jehovah spoke further to Moses, saying:

3371.label: Leviticus 22:2
3371.text: “Speak to Aaron and his sons, that they may keep themselves separate from the holy things of the sons of Israel and not profane my holy name in the things they are sanctifying to me. I am Jehovah.

3372.label: Leviticus 22:3
3372.text: Say to them, ‘Throughout YOUR generations any man of all YOUR offspring who comes near to the holy things, which the sons of Israel will sanctify to Jehovah, while his uncleanness is upon him, that soul must be cut off from before me. I am Jehovah.

3373.label: Leviticus 22:4
3373.text: No man of Aaron’s offspring when he is leprous or has a running discharge may eat of the holy things until he becomes clean, neither he who touches anyone unclean by a deceased soul or a man from whom there goes out a seminal emission,

3374.label: Leviticus 22:5
3374.text: nor a man who touches any swarming thing that is unclean for him or touches a man who is unclean for him as respects any uncleanness of his.

3375.label: Leviticus 22:6
3375.text: The soul who touches any such must be unclean until the evening and may not eat any of the holy things, but he must bathe his flesh in water.

3376.label: Leviticus 22:7
3376.text: When the sun has set, he must also be clean, and afterward he may eat some of the holy things, because it is his bread.

3377.label: Leviticus 22:8
3377.text: He should also not eat any body [already] dead or anything torn by wild beasts so as to become unclean by it. I am Jehovah.

3378.label: Leviticus 22:9
3378.text: “‘And they must keep their obligation to me, that they may not carry sin because of it and have to die for it because they were profaning it. I am Jehovah who is sanctifying them.

3379.label: Leviticus 22:10
3379.text: “‘And no stranger at all may eat anything holy. No settler with a priest nor a hired laborer may eat anything holy.

3380.label: Leviticus 22:11
3380.text: But in case a priest should purchase a soul, as a purchase with his money, he as such may share in eating it. As for slaves born in his house, they as such may share in eating his bread.

3381.label: Leviticus 22:12
3381.text: And in case the daughter of a priest should become a man’s who is a stranger, she as such may not eat of the contribution of the holy things.

3382.label: Leviticus 22:13
3382.text: But in case the daughter of a priest should become a widow or divorced when she has no offspring, and she must return to her father’s house as in her youth, she may eat some of her father’s bread; but no stranger at all may feed on it.

3383.label: Leviticus 22:14
3383.text: “‘Now in case a man eats a holy thing by mistake, he must then add the fifth of it to it and must give the holy thing to the priest.

3384.label: Leviticus 22:15
3384.text: So they should not profane the holy things of the sons of Israel, which they may contribute to Jehovah,

3385.label: Leviticus 22:16
3385.text: and actually cause them to bear the punishment of guiltiness because of their eating their holy things; for I am Jehovah who is sanctifying them.’”

3386.label: Leviticus 22:17
3386.text: And Jehovah continued to speak to Moses, saying:

3387.label: Leviticus 22:18
3387.text: “Speak to Aaron and his sons and all the sons of Israel, and you must say to them, ‘As for any man of the house of Israel or some alien resident in Israel who presents his offering, for any of their vows or for any of their voluntary offerings, which they may present to Jehovah for a burnt offering,

3388.label: Leviticus 22:19
3388.text: to gain approval for YOU it must be sound, a male among the herd, among the young rams or among the goats.

3389.label: Leviticus 22:20
3389.text: Anything in which there is a defect YOU must not present, because it will not serve to gain approval for YOU.

3390.label: Leviticus 22:21
3390.text: “‘And in case a man should present a communion sacrifice to Jehovah in order to pay a vow or as a voluntary offering, it should prove to be a sound one among the herd or the flock, in order to gain approval. No defect at all should prove to be in it.

3391.label: Leviticus 22:22
3391.text: No case of blindness or fracture or having a cut or wart or scabbiness or ringworm, none of these must YOU present to Jehovah, and no offering made by fire from them must YOU put upon the altar for Jehovah.

3392.label: Leviticus 22:23
3392.text: As for a bull or a sheep having a member too long or too short, you may make it a voluntary offering; but for a vow it will not be accepted with approval.

3393.label: Leviticus 22:24
3393.text: But one having the testicles squeezed or crushed or pulled off or cut off YOU must not present to Jehovah, and in YOUR land YOU should not render them up.

3394.label: Leviticus 22:25
3394.text: And any of all these from the hand of a foreigner YOU must not present as the bread of YOUR God, because their corruption is in them. There is a defect in them. They will not be accepted with approval of YOU.’”

3395.label: Leviticus 22:26
3395.text: And Jehovah spoke further to Moses, saying:

3396.label: Leviticus 22:27
3396.text: “Should a bull or a young ram or a goat be born, then it must continue under its mother seven days, but from the eighth day and forward it will be accepted with approval as an offering, an offering made by fire to Jehovah.

3397.label: Leviticus 22:28
3397.text: As for a bull and a sheep, YOU must not slaughter it and its young one on the one day.

3398.label: Leviticus 22:29
3398.text: “And in case YOU should sacrifice a thanksgiving sacrifice to Jehovah, YOU should sacrifice it to gain approval for YOU.

3399.label: Leviticus 22:30
3399.text: On that day it should be eaten. YOU must not leave any of it until morning. I am Jehovah.

3400.label: Leviticus 22:31
3400.text: “And YOU must keep my commandments and do them. I am Jehovah.

3401.label: Leviticus 22:32
3401.text: And YOU must not profane my holy name, and I must be sanctified in the midst of the sons of Israel. I am Jehovah who is sanctifying YOU,

3402.label: Leviticus 22:33
3402.text: the One bringing YOU out of the land of Egypt to prove myself God to YOU. I am Jehovah.”

3403.label: Leviticus 23:1
3403.text: And Jehovah went on speaking to Moses, saying:

3404.label: Leviticus 23:2
3404.text: “Speak to the sons of Israel, and you must say to them, ‘The seasonal festivals of Jehovah that YOU should proclaim are holy conventions. These are my seasonal festivals:

3405.label: Leviticus 23:3
3405.text: “‘Six days may work be done, but on the seventh day is a sabbath of complete rest, a holy convention. YOU may do no sort of work. It is a sabbath to Jehovah in all places where YOU dwell.

3406.label: Leviticus 23:4
3406.text: “‘These are the seasonal festivals of Jehovah, holy conventions, which YOU should proclaim at their appointed times:

3407.label: Leviticus 23:5
3407.text: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, between the two evenings is the passover to Jehovah.

3408.label: Leviticus 23:6
3408.text: “‘And on the fifteenth day of this month is the festival of unfermented cakes to Jehovah. Seven days YOU should eat unfermented cakes.

3409.label: Leviticus 23:7
3409.text: On the first day YOU will have a holy convention occur. No sort of laborious work may YOU do.

3410.label: Leviticus 23:8
3410.text: But YOU must present an offering made by fire to Jehovah seven days. On the seventh day there will be a holy convention. No sort of laborious work may YOU do.’”

3411.label: Leviticus 23:9
3411.text: And Jehovah continued to speak to Moses, saying:

3412.label: Leviticus 23:10
3412.text: “Speak to the sons of Israel, and you must say to them, ‘When YOU eventually come into the land that I am giving YOU, and YOU have reaped its harvest, YOU must also bring a sheaf of the firstfruits of YOUR harvest to the priest.

3413.label: Leviticus 23:11
3413.text: And he must wave the sheaf to and fro before Jehovah to gain approval for YOU. Directly the day after the sabbath the priest should wave it to and fro.

3414.label: Leviticus 23:12
3414.text: And on the day of YOUR having the sheaf waved to and fro YOU must render up a sound young ram, in its first year, for a burnt offering to Jehovah;

3415.label: Leviticus 23:13
3415.text: and as its grain offering two tenths of an eʹphah of fine flour moistened with oil, as an offering made by fire to Jehovah, a restful odor; and as its drink offering a fourth of a hin of wine.

3416.label: Leviticus 23:14
3416.text: And YOU must eat no bread nor roasted grain nor new grain until this very day, until YOUR bringing the offering of YOUR God. It is a statute to time indefinite for YOUR generations in all places where YOU dwell.

3417.label: Leviticus 23:15
3417.text: “‘And YOU must count for yourselves from the day after the sabbath, from the day of YOUR bringing the sheaf of the wave offering, seven sabbaths. They should prove to be complete.

3418.label: Leviticus 23:16
3418.text: To the day after the seventh sabbath YOU should count, fifty days, and YOU must present a new grain offering to Jehovah.

3419.label: Leviticus 23:17
3419.text: Out of YOUR dwelling places YOU should bring two loaves as a wave offering. Of two tenths of an eʹphah of fine flour they should prove to be. They should be baked leavened, as first ripe fruits to Jehovah.

3420.label: Leviticus 23:18
3420.text: And YOU must present along with the loaves seven sound male lambs, each a year old, and one young bull and two rams. They should serve as a burnt offering to Jehovah along with their grain offering and their drink offerings as an offering made by fire, of a restful odor to Jehovah.

3421.label: Leviticus 23:19
3421.text: And YOU must render up one kid of the goats as a sin offering and two male lambs, each a year old, as a communion sacrifice.

3422.label: Leviticus 23:20
3422.text: And the priest must wave them to and fro along with the loaves of the first ripe fruits, as a wave offering before Jehovah, along with the two male lambs. They should serve as something holy to Jehovah for the priest.

3423.label: Leviticus 23:21
3423.text: And YOU must make a proclamation on this very day; there will be a holy convention for yourselves. No sort of laborious work may YOU do. It is a statute to time indefinite in all YOUR dwelling places for YOUR generations.

3424.label: Leviticus 23:22
3424.text: “‘And when YOU people reap the harvest of YOUR land, you must not do completely the edge of your field when you are reaping, and the gleaning of your harvest you must not pick up. You should leave them for the afflicted one and the alien resident. I am Jehovah YOUR God.’”

3425.label: Leviticus 23:23
3425.text: And Jehovah went on speaking to Moses, saying:

3426.label: Leviticus 23:24
3426.text: “Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, ‘In the seventh month, on the first of the month, there should occur for YOU a complete rest, a memorial by the trumpet blast, a holy convention.

3427.label: Leviticus 23:25
3427.text: No sort of laborious work may YOU do, and YOU must present an offering made by fire to Jehovah.’”

3428.label: Leviticus 23:26
3428.text: And Jehovah spoke further to Moses, saying:

3429.label: Leviticus 23:27
3429.text: “However, on the tenth of this seventh month is the day of atonement. A holy convention should take place for YOU, and YOU must afflict YOUR souls and present an offering made by fire to Jehovah.

3430.label: Leviticus 23:28
3430.text: And YOU must do no sort of work on this very day, because it is a day of atonement to make atonement for YOU before Jehovah YOUR God;

3431.label: Leviticus 23:29
3431.text: because every soul that will not be afflicted on this very day must be cut off from his people.

3432.label: Leviticus 23:30
3432.text: As for any soul that will do any sort of work on this very day, I must destroy that soul from among his people.

3433.label: Leviticus 23:31
3433.text: YOU must do no sort of work. It is a statute to time indefinite for YOUR generations in all places where YOU dwell.

3434.label: Leviticus 23:32
3434.text: It is a sabbath of complete rest for YOU, and YOU must afflict YOUR souls on the ninth of the month in the evening. From evening to evening YOU should observe YOUR sabbath.”

3435.label: Leviticus 23:33
3435.text: And Jehovah continued to speak to Moses, saying:

3436.label: Leviticus 23:34
3436.text: “Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, ‘On the fifteenth day of this seventh month is the festival of booths for seven days to Jehovah.

3437.label: Leviticus 23:35
3437.text: On the first day is a holy convention. No sort of laborious work may YOU do.

3438.label: Leviticus 23:36
3438.text: Seven days YOU should present an offering made by fire to Jehovah. On the eighth day there should occur a holy convention for YOU, and YOU must present an offering made by fire to Jehovah. It is a solemn assembly. No sort of laborious work may YOU do.

3439.label: Leviticus 23:37
3439.text: “‘These are the seasonal festivals of Jehovah that YOU should proclaim as holy conventions, for presenting an offering made by fire to Jehovah: the burnt offering and the grain offering of the sacrifice and the drink offerings according to the daily schedule,

3440.label: Leviticus 23:38
3440.text: besides the sabbaths of Jehovah and besides YOUR gifts and besides all YOUR vow offerings and besides all YOUR voluntary offerings, which YOU should give to Jehovah.

3441.label: Leviticus 23:39
3441.text: However, on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when YOU have gathered the produce of the land, YOU should celebrate the festival of Jehovah seven days. On the first day is a complete rest and on the eighth day is a complete rest.

3442.label: Leviticus 23:40
3442.text: And YOU must take for yourselves on the first day the fruit of splendid trees, the fronds of palm trees and the boughs of branchy trees and poplars of the torrent valley, and YOU must rejoice before Jehovah YOUR God seven days.

3443.label: Leviticus 23:41
3443.text: And YOU must celebrate it as a festival to Jehovah seven days in the year. As a statute to time indefinite during YOUR generations, YOU should celebrate it in the seventh month.

3444.label: Leviticus 23:42
3444.text: It is in the booths YOU should dwell seven days. All the natives in Israel should dwell in the booths,

3445.label: Leviticus 23:43
3445.text: in order that YOUR generations may know that it was in the booths that I made the sons of Israel to dwell when I was bringing them out of the land of Egypt. I am Jehovah YOUR God.’”

3446.label: Leviticus 23:44
3446.text: Accordingly Moses spoke of the seasonal festivals of Jehovah to the sons of Israel.

3447.label: Leviticus 24:1
3447.text: And Jehovah proceeded to speak to Moses, saying:

3448.label: Leviticus 24:2
3448.text: “Command the sons of Israel that they get for you pure, beaten olive oil for the luminary, to light up the lamp constantly.

3449.label: Leviticus 24:3
3449.text: Outside the curtain of the Testimony in the tent of meeting Aaron should set it in order from evening to morning before Jehovah constantly. It is a statute to time indefinite during YOUR generations.

3450.label: Leviticus 24:4
3450.text: Upon the lampstand of pure gold he should set the lamps in order before Jehovah constantly.

3451.label: Leviticus 24:5
3451.text: “And you must take fine flour and bake it up into twelve ring-shaped cakes. Two tenths of an eʹphah should go to each ring-shaped cake.

3452.label: Leviticus 24:6
3452.text: And you must place them in two sets of layers, six to the layer set, upon the table of pure gold before Jehovah.

3453.label: Leviticus 24:7
3453.text: And you must put pure frankincense upon each layer set, and it must serve as the bread for a remembrancer, an offering made by fire to Jehovah.

3454.label: Leviticus 24:8
3454.text: On one sabbath day after another he should set it in order before Jehovah constantly. It is a covenant to time indefinite with the sons of Israel.

3455.label: Leviticus 24:9
3455.text: And it must become Aaron’s and his sons’, and they must eat it in a holy place, because it is something most holy for him from Jehovah’s offerings made by fire, as a regulation to time indefinite.”

3456.label: Leviticus 24:10
3456.text: Now a son of an Israelite woman, who, however, was the son of an Egyptian man, went out into the midst of the sons of Israel, and the son of the Israelitess and an Israelite man began to struggle with each other in the camp.

3457.label: Leviticus 24:11
3457.text: And the son of the Israelite woman began to abuse the Name and to call down evil upon it. So they brought him to Moses. Incidentally, his mother’s name was She·loʹmith, the daughter of Dibʹri of the tribe of Dan.

3458.label: Leviticus 24:12
3458.text: Then they committed him into custody till there should be a distinct declaration to them according to the saying of Jehovah.

3459.label: Leviticus 24:13
3459.text: And Jehovah proceeded to speak to Moses, saying:

3460.label: Leviticus 24:14
3460.text: “Bring forth the one who called down evil to the outside of the camp; and all those who heard him must lay their hands upon his head, and the entire assembly must pelt him [with stones].

3461.label: Leviticus 24:15
3461.text: And you should speak to the sons of Israel, saying, ‘In case any man calls down evil upon his God, he must then answer for his sin.

3462.label: Leviticus 24:16
3462.text: So the abuser of Jehovah’s name should be put to death without fail. The entire assembly should without fail pelt him with stones. The alien resident the same as the native should be put to death for his abusing the Name.

3463.label: Leviticus 24:17
3463.text: “‘And in case a man strikes any soul of mankind fatally, he should be put to death without fail.

3464.label: Leviticus 24:18
3464.text: And the fatal striker of the soul of a domestic animal should make compensation for it, soul for soul.

3465.label: Leviticus 24:19
3465.text: And in case a man should cause a defect in his associate, then just as he has done, so it should be done to him.

3466.label: Leviticus 24:20
3466.text: Fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth; the same sort of defect he may cause in the man, that is what should be caused in him.

3467.label: Leviticus 24:21
3467.text: And the fatal striker of a beast should make compensation for it, but the fatal striker of a man should be put to death.

3468.label: Leviticus 24:22
3468.text: “‘One judicial decision should hold good for YOU. The alien resident should prove to be the same as the native, because I am Jehovah YOUR God.’”

3469.label: Leviticus 24:23
3469.text: After that Moses spoke to the sons of Israel, and they brought forth the one who had called down evil to the outside of the camp, and they pelted him with stones. Thus the sons of Israel did just as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

3470.label: Leviticus 25:1
3470.text: And Jehovah spoke further to Moses in Mount Siʹnai, saying:

3471.label: Leviticus 25:2
3471.text: “Speak to the sons of Israel, and you must say to them, ‘When YOU eventually come into the land that I am giving YOU, then the land must observe a sabbath to Jehovah.

3472.label: Leviticus 25:3
3472.text: Six years you should sow your field with seed, and six years you should prune your vineyard, and you must gather the land’s produce.

3473.label: Leviticus 25:4
3473.text: But in the seventh year there should occur a sabbath of complete rest for the land, a sabbath to Jehovah. Your field you must not sow with seed, and your vineyard you must not prune.

3474.label: Leviticus 25:5
3474.text: The growth from spilled kernels of your harvest you must not reap, and the grapes of your unpruned vine you must not gather. There should occur a year of complete rest for the land.

3475.label: Leviticus 25:6
3475.text: And the sabbath of the land must serve YOU people for food, for you and your slave man and your slave girl and your hired laborer and the settler with you, those who are residing as aliens with you,

3476.label: Leviticus 25:7
3476.text: and for your domestic animal and for the wild beast that is in your land. All its produce should serve for eating.

3477.label: Leviticus 25:8
3477.text: “‘And you must count for yourself seven sabbaths of years, seven times seven years, and the days of the seven sabbaths of years must amount to forty-nine years for you.

3478.label: Leviticus 25:9
3478.text: And you must cause the horn of loud tone to sound in the seventh month on the tenth of the month; on the day of atonement YOU people should cause the horn to sound in all YOUR land.

3479.label: Leviticus 25:10
3479.text: And YOU must sanctify the fiftieth year and proclaim liberty in the land to all its inhabitants. It will become a Jubilee for YOU, and YOU must return each one to his possession and YOU should return each one to his family.

3480.label: Leviticus 25:11
3480.text: A Jubilee is what that fiftieth year will become for YOU. YOU must not sow seed nor reap the land’s growth from spilled kernels nor gather the grapes of its unpruned vines.

3481.label: Leviticus 25:12
3481.text: For it is a Jubilee. It should become something holy to YOU. From the field YOU may eat what the land produces.

3482.label: Leviticus 25:13
3482.text: “‘In this year of the Jubilee YOU should return each one to his possession.

3483.label: Leviticus 25:14
3483.text: Now in case YOU should sell merchandise to your associate or be buying from your associate’s hand, do not YOU wrong one another.

3484.label: Leviticus 25:15
3484.text: By the number of the years after the Jubilee you should buy from your associate; by the number of the years of the crops he should sell to you.

3485.label: Leviticus 25:16
3485.text: In proportion to the great number of years he should increase its purchase value, and in proportion to the fewness of years he should reduce its purchase value, because the number of the crops is what he is selling to you.

3486.label: Leviticus 25:17
3486.text: And YOU must not wrong anyone his associate, and you must be in fear of your God, because I am Jehovah YOUR God.

3487.label: Leviticus 25:18
3487.text: So YOU must carry out my statutes and YOU should keep my judicial decisions and YOU must carry them out. Then YOU will certainly dwell on the land in security.

3488.label: Leviticus 25:19
3488.text: And the land will indeed give its fruitage, and YOU will certainly eat to satisfaction and dwell in security on it.

3489.label: Leviticus 25:20
3489.text: “‘But in case YOU should say: “What are we going to eat in the seventh year seeing that we may not sow seed or gather our crops?”

3490.label: Leviticus 25:21
3490.text: in that case I shall certainly command my blessing for YOU in the sixth year, and it must yield its crop for three years.

3491.label: Leviticus 25:22
3491.text: And YOU must sow seed the eighth year and YOU must eat from the old crop until the ninth year. Until the coming of its crop YOU will eat the old.

3492.label: Leviticus 25:23
3492.text: “‘So the land should not be sold in perpetuity, because the land is mine. For YOU are alien residents and settlers from my standpoint.

3493.label: Leviticus 25:24
3493.text: And in all the land of YOUR possession YOU should grant to the land the right of buying back.

3494.label: Leviticus 25:25
3494.text: “‘In case your brother grows poor and has to sell some of his possession, a repurchaser closely related to him must also come and buy back what his brother sold.

3495.label: Leviticus 25:26
3495.text: And in case anyone proves to have no repurchaser and his own hand does make gain and he does find enough for its repurchase,

3496.label: Leviticus 25:27
3496.text: he must also calculate the years from when he sold it and he must return what money remains over to the man to whom he made the sale, and he must return to his possession.

3497.label: Leviticus 25:28
3497.text: “‘But if his hand does not find enough to give back to him, what he sold must also continue in the hand of its purchaser until the Jubilee year; and it must go out in the Jubilee, and he must return to his possession.

3498.label: Leviticus 25:29
3498.text: “‘Now in case a man should sell a dwelling house in a walled city, his right of repurchase must also continue till the year from the time of his sale finishes out; his right of repurchase should continue a whole year.

3499.label: Leviticus 25:30
3499.text: But if it should not be bought back before the complete year has come to the full for him, the house that is in the city that has a wall must also stand in perpetuity as the property of its purchaser during his generations. It should not go out in the Jubilee.

3500.label: Leviticus 25:31
3500.text: However, the houses of settlements that have no wall about them should be accounted as part of the field of the country. Right of repurchase should continue for it, and in the Jubilee it should go out.

3501.label: Leviticus 25:32
3501.text: “‘As for cities of the Levites with the houses of the cities of their possession, the right of repurchase should continue to time indefinite for the Levites.

3502.label: Leviticus 25:33
3502.text: And where property of the Levites is not bought back, the house sold in the city of his possession must also go out in the Jubilee; because the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession in the midst of the sons of Israel.

3503.label: Leviticus 25:34
3503.text: Moreover, the field of pasture ground of their cities may not be sold, because it is a possession to time indefinite for them.

3504.label: Leviticus 25:35
3504.text: “‘And in case your brother grows poor and so he is financially weak alongside you, you must also sustain him. As an alien resident and a settler, he must keep alive with you.

3505.label: Leviticus 25:36
3505.text: Do not take interest and usury from him, but you must be in fear of your God; and your brother must keep alive with you.

3506.label: Leviticus 25:37
3506.text: You must not give him your money on interest, and you must not give your food out on usury.

3507.label: Leviticus 25:38
3507.text: I am Jehovah YOUR God, who brought YOU out of the land of Egypt to give YOU the land of Caʹnaan, to prove myself YOUR God.

3508.label: Leviticus 25:39
3508.text: “‘And in case your brother grows poor alongside you and he has to sell himself to you, you must not use him as a worker in slavish service.

3509.label: Leviticus 25:40
3509.text: He should prove to be with you like a hired laborer, like a settler. He should serve with you till the Jubilee year.

3510.label: Leviticus 25:41
3510.text: And he must go out from you, he and his sons with him, and he must return to his family, and he should return to the possession of his forefathers.

3511.label: Leviticus 25:42
3511.text: For they are my slaves whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. They must not sell themselves the way a slave is sold.

3512.label: Leviticus 25:43
3512.text: You must not tread down upon him with tyranny, and you must be in fear of your God.

3513.label: Leviticus 25:44
3513.text: As for your slave man and your slave girl who become yours from the nations that are round about YOU people, from them YOU may buy a slave man and a slave girl.

3514.label: Leviticus 25:45
3514.text: And also from the sons of the settlers who are residing as aliens with YOU, from them YOU may buy, and from their families that are with YOU whom they had born to them in YOUR land; and they must become YOUR possession.

3515.label: Leviticus 25:46
3515.text: And YOU must pass them on as an inheritance to YOUR sons after YOU to inherit as a possession to time indefinite. YOU may use them as workers, but upon YOUR brothers the sons of Israel, you must not tread, the one upon the other, with tyranny.

3516.label: Leviticus 25:47
3516.text: “‘But in case the hand of the alien resident or the settler with you becomes wealthy, and your brother has become poor alongside him and must sell himself to the alien resident or the settler with you, or to a member of the family of the alien resident,

3517.label: Leviticus 25:48
3517.text: after he has sold himself, the right of repurchase will continue in his case. One of his brothers may buy him back.

3518.label: Leviticus 25:49
3518.text: Or his uncle or the son of his uncle may buy him back, or any blood relative of his flesh, one of his family, may buy him back. “‘Or if his own hand has become wealthy, he must also buy himself back.

3519.label: Leviticus 25:50
3519.text: And he must reckon with his purchaser from the year he sold himself to him till the Jubilee year, and the money of his sale must correspond with the number of years. The way workdays of a hired laborer are reckoned he should continue with him.

3520.label: Leviticus 25:51
3520.text: If there are yet many years, he should in proportion to them pay his repurchase price over from the money of his purchase.

3521.label: Leviticus 25:52
3521.text: But if only a few remain of the years until the Jubilee year, he must then make a calculation for himself. In proportion to the years of his he should pay over his repurchase price.

3522.label: Leviticus 25:53
3522.text: He should continue with him like a hired laborer from year to year. He may not tread him down with tyranny before your eyes.

3523.label: Leviticus 25:54
3523.text: However, if he cannot buy himself back on these terms, he must then go out in the year of Jubilee, he and his sons with him.

3524.label: Leviticus 25:55
3524.text: “‘For to me the sons of Israel are slaves. They are my slaves whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. I am Jehovah YOUR God.

3525.label: Leviticus 26:1
3525.text: “‘YOU must not make valueless gods for yourselves, and YOU must not set up a carved image or a sacred pillar for yourselves, and YOU must not put a stone as a showpiece in YOUR land in order to bow down toward it; for I am Jehovah YOUR God.

3526.label: Leviticus 26:2
3526.text: YOU should keep my sabbaths and stand in awe of my sanctuary. I am Jehovah.

3527.label: Leviticus 26:3
3527.text: “‘If YOU continue walking in my statutes and keeping my commandments and YOU do carry them out,

3528.label: Leviticus 26:4
3528.text: I shall also certainly give YOUR showers of rain at their proper time, and the land will indeed give its yield, and the tree of the field will give its fruit.

3529.label: Leviticus 26:5
3529.text: And YOUR threshing will certainly reach to YOUR grape gathering, and the grape gathering will reach to the sowing of seed; and YOU will indeed eat YOUR bread to satisfaction and dwell in security in YOUR land.

3530.label: Leviticus 26:6
3530.text: And I will put peace in the land, and YOU will indeed lie down, with no one making [YOU] tremble; and I will make the injurious wild beast cease out of the land, and a sword will not pass through YOUR land.

3531.label: Leviticus 26:7
3531.text: And YOU will certainly chase YOUR enemies, and they will indeed fall before YOU by the sword.

3532.label: Leviticus 26:8
3532.text: And five of YOU will certainly chase a hundred, and a hundred of YOU will chase ten thousand, and YOUR enemies will indeed fall before YOU by the sword.

3533.label: Leviticus 26:9
3533.text: “‘And I will turn myself to YOU and make YOU fruitful and multiply YOU, and I will carry out my covenant with YOU.

3534.label: Leviticus 26:10
3534.text: And YOU will certainly eat the old of the preceding year, and YOU will bring out the old ahead of the new.

3535.label: Leviticus 26:11
3535.text: And I shall certainly put my tabernacle in the midst of YOU, and my soul will not abhor YOU.

3536.label: Leviticus 26:12
3536.text: And I shall indeed walk in the midst of YOU and prove myself YOUR God, and YOU, on YOUR part, will prove yourselves my people.

3537.label: Leviticus 26:13
3537.text: I am Jehovah YOUR God, who brought YOU out of the land of Egypt from acting as slaves to them, and I proceeded to break the bars of YOUR yoke and make YOU walk erect.

3538.label: Leviticus 26:14
3538.text: “‘However, if YOU will not listen to me nor do all these commandments,

3539.label: Leviticus 26:15
3539.text: and if YOU will reject my statutes, and if YOUR souls will abhor my judicial decisions so as not to do all my commandments, to the extent of YOUR violating my covenant,

3540.label: Leviticus 26:16
3540.text: then I, for my part, shall do the following to YOU, and in punishment I shall certainly bring upon YOU disturbance with tuberculosis and burning fever, causing the eyes to fail and making the soul pine away. And YOU will simply sow YOUR seed for nothing, as YOUR enemies will certainly eat it up.

3541.label: Leviticus 26:17
3541.text: And I shall indeed set my face against YOU, and YOU will certainly be defeated before YOUR enemies; and those who hate YOU will just tread down upon YOU, and YOU will actually flee when no one is pursuing YOU.

3542.label: Leviticus 26:18
3542.text: “‘If, though, despite these things, YOU will not listen to me, I shall then have to chastise YOU seven times as much for YOUR sins.

3543.label: Leviticus 26:19
3543.text: And I shall have to break the pride of YOUR strength and make YOUR heavens like iron and YOUR earth like copper.

3544.label: Leviticus 26:20
3544.text: And YOUR power will simply be expended for nothing, as YOUR earth will not give its yield, and the tree of the earth will not give its fruit.

3545.label: Leviticus 26:21
3545.text: “‘But if YOU keep walking in opposition to me and not wishing to listen to me, I shall then have to inflict seven times more blows upon YOU according to YOUR sins.

3546.label: Leviticus 26:22
3546.text: And I will send the wild beasts of the field among YOU, and they will certainly bereave YOU of children and cut off YOUR domestic animals and reduce the number of YOU, and YOUR roads will actually be desolated.

3547.label: Leviticus 26:23
3547.text: “‘Nevertheless, if with these things YOU do not let yourselves be corrected by me and YOU just have to walk in opposition to me,

3548.label: Leviticus 26:24
3548.text: I, yes, I, shall then have to walk in opposition to YOU; and I, even I, shall have to strike YOU seven times for YOUR sins.

3549.label: Leviticus 26:25
3549.text: And I shall certainly bring upon YOU a sword wreaking vengeance for the covenant; and YOU will indeed gather yourselves into YOUR cities, and I shall certainly send pestilence into the midst of YOU, and YOU must be given into the hand of an enemy.

3550.label: Leviticus 26:26
3550.text: When I have broken for YOU the rods around which ring-shaped loaves are suspended, ten women will then actually bake YOUR bread in but one oven and give back YOUR bread by weight; and YOU must eat but YOU will not be satisfied.

3551.label: Leviticus 26:27
3551.text: “‘If, however, with this YOU will not listen to me and YOU just must walk in opposition to me,

3552.label: Leviticus 26:28
3552.text: I shall then have to walk in heated opposition to YOU, and I, yes, I, shall have to chastise YOU seven times for YOUR sins.

3553.label: Leviticus 26:29
3553.text: So YOU will have to eat the flesh of YOUR sons, and YOU will eat the flesh of YOUR daughters.

3554.label: Leviticus 26:30
3554.text: And I shall certainly annihilate YOUR sacred high places and cut off YOUR incense stands and lay YOUR own carcasses upon the carcasses of YOUR dungy idols; and my soul will simply abhor YOU.

3555.label: Leviticus 26:31
